blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Overhead aerial imagery feeds dense-prediction pipelines that are routinely trained in one geographic region and deployed in another, yet no benchmark measures how shadow detection models transfer across regions. Existing overhead shadow datasets either lack a geographic transfer protocol or rely on automatically generated labels. We introduce ShadowTransfer, a benchmark of 4,500 human-verified shadow masks across three U.S. cities at two native resolutions, paired with a leave-one-city-out evaluation protocol. Under vanilla training, holding out the test city costs 3.5 to 7.8 mIoU across four architectures, the gap remains significant when the training set grows from 225 to 900 images, and six of eight adaptation methods degrade more than vanilla training on average. We propose a three-probe framework that diagnoses where and how the transfer breaks: the failure operates in feature space, beyond the reach of pixel-histogram matching, shows up as a confidence collapse on shadow pixels while background confidence stays intact, and is recoverable by retraining different architectural components depending on the model: encoder for some, decoder for others. These findings replicate on INRIA building footprints, suggesting they describe geographic transfer beyond shadows. Guided by the diagnosis, we build Spectral Information Bottleneck (SIB), a plug-in module with one component per finding. Across the 9 (architecture, held-out city) cells, SIB has the smallest mean gap to the within-city upper bound of the ten methods we evaluate (6.42 mIoU), level with FDA. The benchmark, LOCO protocol, code, and trained models are released to support reproducible evaluation of geographic transfer in overhead dense prediction.
blocks.zh: 地面航空图象为一个地理区域例行训练的、部署在另一个地理区域的密集预测管道提供素材,但没有衡量阴影探测模型如何跨区域转移的基准。 现有的俯冲阴影数据集要么缺乏地理传输协议,要么依赖自动生成的标签. 我们引入了Shadow Transfer(Shadow Transfer),这是美国三个城市的4500个经人验证的影子面具的基准,通过两个本土分辨率,配以一个留守一城评估协议. 在香草培训下,测试城市的费用为3.5至7.8mIoU,涉及四种建筑,如果培训从225个图像增加到900个图像,差距仍然很大,8种适应方法中有6种比香草培训平均降低更多。 我们提出一个诊断传输中断地点和方式的三试框架:失败在像素-视象图匹配所无法达到的特征空间中运行,表现为阴影像素上的置信性崩溃,而背景置信性保持完好无损,并且根据模型再培训不同的建筑构件是可以恢复的:为一些人编码,为其他人解码. 这些发现复制了INRIA建筑脚印,表明它们描述了超越阴影的地域转移. 在诊断的指导下,我们建造了Spectral Information Bottleneck(SIB),一个插件模块,每个发现有一个组件. 在9个(建筑,被扣留的城市)细胞中,SIB与我们评价的十种方法(6.42 mIoU)的市内上界(FDA)的距离最小。 发布了基准、LOCO协议、代码和训练有素的模型,以支持对高密度预测中的地理转移进行可复制的评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Overhead aerial imagery feeds segmentation pipelines that are deployed across geographic regions. Shadow masks are a core input to several of these pipelines: solar irradiance estimation uses them to separate shaded from sunlit surfaces [ 1 ] , urban heat mapping uses them to correct surface temperature readings [ 2 , 3 ] , and building footprint extraction uses them to resolve occlusion boundaries [ 4 ] . These pipelines are routinely trained on data from one region and deployed in another [ 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 跨地理区域部署的海面航空图象输送管道。 阴影遮罩是其中几个管道的核心输入:太阳辐照估计用它来隔开遮阳面[1],城市热映射用它来校正表面温度读数[2,3],建筑脚印提取用它来解决隔离边界[4]. 这些管道定期接受来自一个区域的数据培训,并部署在另一个区域[5、6]。

blocks.en: Geographic shift is a known failure mode in segmentation models across domains. Medical imaging models underperform across hospitals due to scanner and protocol differences [ 7 ] , and aerial land-cover models show similar drops on unseen regions [ 8 , 9 ] . For overhead shadow detection, no comparable evaluation infrastructure exists. AISD, the largest human-verified overhead shadow dataset, contains 514 images and defines no train-test split across cities [ 10 ] . S-EO scales further but relies on automatically generated masks with documented alignment artifacts, and again reports no geographic holdout [ 4 ] . Other widely used shadow benchmarks (SBU, ISTD) target ground-level imagery and do not match overhead geometry [ 11 , 12 ] . Table 1 summarizes the landscape. Without a benchmark that pairs human-verified labels with a defined geographic protocol, transfer failure in overhead shadow detection cannot be measured, diagnosed, or addressed.
blocks.zh: 地理变化是跨域分割模型中已知的一种故障模式. 由于扫描仪和协议的差异,各医院的医学成像模型表现不佳[7],空中陆地覆盖模型显示,在看不见的区域有类似的下降[8,9]。 关于间接阴影探测,没有类似的评价基础设施。 AISD是最大的经人验证的俯冲阴影数据集,包含514个图像,并且定义了没有在城市间分割的列车测试[10]. S-EO尺度进一步,但依靠自动生成的口罩和有文件证明的对齐文物,并且再次报告没有地理阻力[4]. 其他广泛使用的阴影基准(SBU,ISTD)针对地面图像,与高架几何不匹配[11,12]. 表1总结了景观。 如果没有将经人验证的标签与界定的地理协议联系起来的基准,就无法衡量、诊断或解决在高空阴影探测中的转移故障。

To bridge this gap, we introduce ShadowTransfer , a benchmark for measuring geographic transfer in overhead shadow detection. It contains 4,500 human-verified shadow masks across three U.S. cities (Chicago, Miami, Phoenix) at two native sensor resolutions (0.3 m and 0.6 m), with a leave-one-city-out (LOCO) protocol that trains on two cities and tests on the third.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Shadow Transfer,这是测量高空阴影探测中的地理转移的基准。 它包含4,500个经过人验证的影子口罩,通过两个本土感应分辨率(0.3米和0.6米),横跨三个美国城市(芝加哥,迈阿密,凤凰城),并带有一个在两个城市进行训练,在第三个城市进行测试的留守一城(LOCO)协议.

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the size of the gap this protocol exposes: under vanilla training on the high-resolution cells, holding out the test city costs between 3.5 3.5 mIoU (CrossEarth) and 7.8 7.8 mIoU (OGLANet), and existing domain-adaptation methods help on some architecture-city pairs and fail catastrophically on others. The major contributions of this work are threefold:

We provide a three-probe evaluation framework that characterizes how models fail under geographic transfer: where in the pipeline the shift acts, how the prediction distribution distorts, and which architectural components carry the failure 3. We present SIB , a case-study module designed from the framework’s findings, with the smallest mean gap to the within-city upper bound of the ten methods we evaluate, level with FDA. Together, the benchmark and framework give practitioners a way to measure geographic transfer risk before deployment and to diagnose where in a model that risk concentrates.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Overhead shadow detection assigns a binary shadow label to every pixel of an aerial or satellite image. The field was established by AISD [ 10 ] , a 514-image manually annotated benchmark spanning five cities at 0.3 m resolution. S-EO [ 4 ] scales to roughly 19,000 images by deriving masks from digital surface models and sun geometry; the authors document temporal-misalignment artifacts and recommend the dataset for training rather than evaluation. Airborne-Shadow [ 13 ] adds a manually annotated overhead set with a heavy/light shadow distinction, but is restricted to German imagery and does not report a geographic split. Recent methods (MAMNet, MBCSANet, CSDFormer, OGLANet) report F1 scores within roughly one point of each other on AISD [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] , indicating that the in-domain benchmark has plateaued. Additionally, ground-level shadow datasets [ 12 , 11 , 18 ] are not substitutes for overhead evaluation: viewing angle, and shadow geometry differ. None of these overhead datasets defines a geographic train-test split, and the most recent overhead shadow survey identifies cross-dataset generalization as an open problem [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 超前阴影探测为空中或卫星图像的每个像素分配二进制阴影标签. 球场由AISD[10]建立,这是人工注释的514图像基准,以0.3m分辨率横跨五个城市. S-EO[4]通过从数字表面模型和太阳几何学中提取口罩,对大约19,000幅图像进行比例测定;作者记录了时间偏差的文物,并建议培训而不是评价数据集。 空降-Shadow [13] 增加了一个手动附加说明的机上设置,并有重/轻的阴影区分,但仅限于德国图像,不报告地理分裂. 近代方法(MAMNet,MBCSANet,CSDFormer,OGLANet)在AISD[14,15,16,17]上报告F1的得分相差约1分,表明域内基准已经趋于平稳. 此外,地层阴影数据集[12,11,18]不能替代间接费用评价:视角,阴影几何学不同. 这些间接费用数据集都没有定义地理列车-测试分割,最近的间接费用阴影调查将跨数据集泛化确定为一个开放问题[19].

blocks.en: A range of methods make dense prediction robust to source-target appearance differences by intervening at one stage of the pipeline. At the input, FDA swaps low-frequency Fourier amplitude between images [ 20 ] , IIM derives illumination-invariant inputs [ 21 ] , and BSM mixes styles within a training batch through a frozen AdaIN network [ 22 ] . In feature space, ISW whitens photometrically sensitive covariance dimensions [ 23 ] , SegDeSiC aligns encoder features through a geo-coordinate regression loss [ 24 ] , MRFP + randomizes high- and low-frequency feature components [ 25 ] , and FADA processes the Haar-wavelet bands of foundation-model features separately [ 26 ] . At test time, TENT minimises prediction entropy over normalisation-layer parameters [ 27 ] , and SAR stabilises this update with sharpness-aware minimisation and by excluding high-entropy samples [ 28 ] . Each method applies its correction at the same locus for every architecture, and no prior work tests whether that locus is consistent across architectures for overhead dense prediction. Remote-sensing foundation models address the shift through the representation instead: CrossEarth trains adapters and a Mask2Former decoder on a frozen DINOv2 backbone, with style augmentation from an external image pool and masked image modelling [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 一系列方法通过在管道的某个阶段进行干预,使密集的预测对源-目标外观差异产生强烈的影响。 在输入时,FDA在图像[20]之间交换低频傅里叶振幅,IIM获得照明-变种输入[21],BSM通过冷冻的AdaIN网络在一个训练批次内混合样式[22]. 在特征空间中,ISW白化的光度敏感共变维度[23],SegDeSiC通过地理坐标回归损失来对编码器特征进行校正[24],MRFP+随机化高频和低频特征组件[25],FADA分别处理基础-模型特征的Haar-波段[26]. 在试验时,TENT在正常化水平参数[27]上将预测的 en最小化,SAR将这一更新稳定在尖锐感知到最小程度,并排除高强度样本[28]。 每一种方法都应用它在同一地点对每个建筑进行校正,而且没有以前的工作测试该地点在各种建筑中是否一致,以便进行高密度的预测。 遥感基础模型则通过表示处理移位: 跨地球列车适配器和冷冻的DINOv2主干线上的Mask2Former解码器,外置图像池的样式增强和蒙面图像建模[9].

blocks.en: 3 The ShadowTransfer Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 影子转让基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Design and City Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集设计和城市选择

blocks.en: ShadowTransfer contains 4,500 4{,}500 RGB patches of size 384 × 384 384{\times}384 pixels, sampled from National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP) orthoimagery across three U.S. cities: Chicago, Miami, and Phoenix. Each city contributes 1,500 1{,}500 patches, split evenly across two native NAIP resolutions, 0.3 0.3 m and 0.6 0.6 m ground sampling distance ( 750 750 patches per city × \times resolution pair). The three cities span distinct urban morphologies and climatic regimes, so the leave-one-city-out protocol in Section 3.3 measures transfer across genuine appearance shifts rather than nearby variants of the same scene type. Other potential confounders (sensor type, image format, file conventions) are held fixed by the shared NAIP source. We retain the two native resolutions rather than synthetically downsampling 0.3 0.3 m imagery, since NAIP releases them as separate native acquisitions with different sensor characteristics; collapsing these differences would understate the gap deployed systems face. Preserving both resolutions also supports future study of resolution shift under the same protocol. Within each city, patches are sampled uniformly inside the administrative boundary, with at most one patch per source NAIP tile to limit spatial autocorrelation. For each city-resolution pair, the 750 750 patches are split into 450 450 training, 150 150 validation, and 150 150 test images, fixed at the benchmark level and released with the dataset. To support resolution-paired analyses, we additionally co-locate 150 150 coordinates per city imaged at both resolutions ( 300 300 paired patches per city). Sampling code, random seeds, and per-patch metadata (city, resolution, longitude/latitude, source tile ID) are released with the benchmark; within-city split distributional diagnostics are in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: Shadow Transfer包含4,500 4{,}500个RGB补丁,尺寸384×384384×Times}384像素,样本来自美国芝加哥,迈阿密,凤凰三个城市的国家农业成像计划(NAIP)整形术. 每个城市贡献1,500个1{,}500个补丁,在两个原生NAIP分辨率,0.3 0.3米和0.6 0.6米地面采样距离(每城市750 750个补丁×\times分辨率对)之间均匀分布. 这三个城市跨越不同的城市形态和气候制度,因此,第3.3节中的“一城一城”协议衡量的是真正的外观变化,而不是同一场景类型的附近变体。 其他潜在的混淆者(传感器类型,图像格式,文件常规)由共享的NAIP源所固定. 我们保留了两种原生分辨率,而不是合成下取样0.3米的图像,因为NAIP作为具有不同感官特性的单独原生获取而释放出来;粉碎这些差异将低估所部署的系统所面临的差距。 保留这两项决议也支持今后根据同一议定书研究决议的转变。 在每个城市内,在行政边界内对补丁进行统一取样,每个源NAIP瓷砖最多有一个补丁,以限制空间的自动化关系。 每对城市分辨率对,750个补丁分为450个450个训练,150个150个验证,150个150个测试图像,固定在基准水平,随数据集发布. 为了支持分辨率分析,我们还根据两项分辨率,将每个城市150个坐标(每个城市300 300对补丁)合用同一地点。 抽样代码,随机种子,以及每幅元数据(城市,分辨率,经度/纬度,源瓷砖ID)随基准发布;城市内部的分割分布诊断在附录D中.

blocks.en: 3.2 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 说明管道

blocks.en: Pixel-level shadow masks are produced by 7 7 trained annotators in a three-phase pipeline that jointly solves throughput and label quality. Phase 1 establishes the label distribution from scratch through human annotation. Phase 2 trains an interim shadow detector on Phase 1 labels and uses its predictions to seed subsequent batches, which annotators edit rather than redraw. Phase 3 is a retroactive quality-control pass that intersects each prior segment with the final-model prediction and returns disagreements for adjudication. Across all phases, every 100 100 -image batch includes 5 5 gold images with frozen reference masks; Cohen’s κ \kappa on these images monitors annotator drift across batches. Each shadow segment carries one of six type labels (taxonomy in Appendix C ); the six-way typing is released for downstream analyses, but the LOCO benchmark in Section 3.3 evaluates binary masks (shadow vs. background). Tooling, per-phase throughput, inter-annotator agreement statistics, and Phase 3 adjudication rules are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 像素层面的影子口罩由7位7位训练有素的注释员在三相管道中生产,共同解决吞吐量和标签质量问题. 第一阶段通过人类注释从头开始确定标签分布. 第2阶段在第1阶段的标签上训练一个临时的影子探测器,并利用它的预测来播种后续的批次,这些批次由注释者编辑而不是重新绘制. 第三阶段是追溯性质量控制通行证,每段前段与最终模型预测相交,返回分歧进行裁定. 在各阶段,每100-100-图像批次包括5个带有冷冻参考口罩的黄金图像;这些图像上的Cohen ox kappa 监视批次的注释器漂移。 每个阴影段都带有6种类型的标签之一(分类学在附录C中);六向打字被发布用于下游分析,但第3.3节中的LOCO基准评价二进制口罩(Shadow vs.背景). 工具、每个阶段的吞吐量、通知人之间的协议统计和第三阶段裁决规则载于附录B。

blocks.en: 3.3 The LOCO Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 联络处议定书

blocks.en: We define the leave-one-city-out (LOCO) protocol over the city set 𝒞 = { Chicago, Miami, Phoenix } \mathcal{C}=\{\text{Chicago, Miami, Phoenix}\} . For each holdout city c ∗ ∈ 𝒞 c^{*}\in\mathcal{C} , the training set is sampled from the two non-holdout cities at a fixed 50 / 50 50/50 ratio, yielding n train = 450 n_{\text{train}}=450 images ( 225 225 per training city). The validation set is n val = 300 n_{\text{val}}=300 images drawn from the same two training cities ( 150 150 per city), and the test set is the held-out city’s 150 150 -image test pool. The within-city upper bound for each (city, resolution) is a model trained on that pair’s 450 450 training images and evaluated on its 150 150 test images, so the LOCO-vs-upper-bound gap isolates geographic shift from training-set scale. All three holdout rotations are evaluated; results aggregate over rotations and the two native resolutions, giving 6 6 test cells per (architecture, method) pair. The primary metric is boundary-tolerant mIoU, the mean of shadow and background IoU with a ± 2 \pm 2 -pixel don’t-care band, since shadow boundaries are inherently imprecise to annotate at sub-pixel resolution; full metric definition and excluded-mask handling are in Appendix E . Per-cell significance uses paired bootstrap on per-image Δ \Delta values ( B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 resamples, two-tailed p p -value against the within-city upper bound).
blocks.zh: 我们定义一个城市的退出协议 C = {芝加哥,迈阿密,菲尼克斯}\ mathcal{C}=\{\text{芝加哥,迈阿密,菲尼克斯}。 对于每个拒收城市 c ∗ C ^{*}\in\ mathcal{C},培训集的样本来自两个非拒收城市,比例固定为50/5050/50,产生n列车=450n_{\text{train{450图像(每个训练城市225/225). 校验组为n val = 300 n_{\text{ val}}=300影像,来自同一两个训练城市(每城市150个150个),测试组为被搁置城市的150个150-图像测试池. 每个城市内部的上方连接(城市,分辨率)是一个模型,该模型训练了这对450个培训图像,并评估了150个测试图像,因此LOCO-vs-upper-completed差距将地理变化与培训设定的规模隔离开来。 对所有三个坚固旋转都进行了评价;结果在旋转和两个原生分辨率上合计,每对试验细胞(architecture,方法)为6个。 主要的衡量标准是耐边界的mIoU, 阴影和背景的IoU的平均值为±2\pm 2-像素不注意带, 因为阴影的边界在子像素分辨率上本质上是不精确的; 完整的参数定义和排除式任务处理载于附录E 。 每个细胞的意义在每幅图像上使用配对的靴子绑在\\Delta值上(B=10,000 B=10{,}000 reamples,双尾 p-值对应于城市内上方的值).

blocks.en: 3.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.4 基线

blocks.en: We evaluate four architectures spanning representative design families: MAMNet [ 14 ] (CNN with criss-cross attention), OGLANet [ 17 ] (CNN with multi-scale prediction-stage output aggregation), DINOv3 [ 29 ] (ViT with self-supervised pretraining, fine-tuned end-to-end), and CrossEarth [ 9 ] (remote-sensing foundation model with a frozen DINOv2 backbone and a Mask2Former decoder). MAMNet, OGLANet and DINOv3 are each paired with nine configurations: Vanilla (source-only, no domain adaptation), FDA [ 20 ] , SegDeSiC [ 24 ] , IIM [ 21 ] , ISW [ 23 ] , MRFP+ [ 25 ] , FADA [ 26 ] , SAR [ 28 ] , and BSM [ 22 ] . Adaptation methods leave the architecture unchanged. The first seven are tested on all 7 × 3 × 3 × 2 = 126 7\times 3\times 3\times 2=126 (method, architecture, holdout city, resolution) configurations, and SAR, BSM and CrossEarth on the high-resolution cells, for 158 158 LOCO test cells of 150 150 images each. Architecture details, pretrained weight sources, and adaptation-method hyperparameters are in Appendix F . Table 2 summarizes results pooled across the three holdouts and two resolutions; per-cell numbers and confidence intervals are in Appendix G . 157 157 of the 158 158 test cells degrade significantly under geographic transfer ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 , paired bootstrap; 151 151 after Bonferroni correction over the 158 158 -test family), with mean LOCO degradation of − 8.34 -8.34 mIoU and a worst single cell of − 28.50 -28.50 mIoU. A data-scaling test indicates that the gap is not a small-data effect: quadrupling the LOCO training set from 225 225 to 900 900 images narrows it by 0.80 0.80 mIoU ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 0.46 , 1.14 ] [0.46,1.14] ), from 6.48 6.48 to 5.50 5.50 , with the upper bound significantly ahead in every cell but one (high resolution, three seeds; Appendix H.1 ). Two findings in Table 2 shape the rest of the paper. First, the cost of an adaptation method depends on the architecture: ISW costs DINOv3 − 18.5 -18.5 mIoU against − 11.1 -11.1 on OGLANet, while MRFP + costs OGLANet − 14.0 -14.0 against − 4.9 -4.9 on DINOv3. Second, no adaptation method is uniformly safe: six of eight adaptation methods degrade more than Vanilla on average (five significantly, Holm p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), and every method except SegDeSiC degrades every cell it is evaluated on, on all four architectures. Without access to the target city, Table 2 gives a practitioner no basis for choosing an adaptation method. Section 4 asks where in the architecture the failure lives and why uniform corrections fail non-uniformly across them.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了跨越代表性设计家族的4个建筑:MAMNet [14](CNN带有criss-cross关注),OGLANet [17](CNN具有多尺度预测阶段产出汇总),DINOv3 [29](ViT带有自我监督的预训,精细调整的端到端),以及跨地[9](远感基础模型带有冻结的DINOv2骨干和一个Mask2Former解码器). MAMNet,OGLANet和DINOv3各配对9个配置: 香草(仅来源,无域改编),FDA [20], SegDeSiC [24], IIM [21], ISW [23], MRFP+ [25], FADA [26], SAR [28], BSM [22]. 适应方法使建筑保持不变。 前7个在全部7×3×3×3×2 = 126 7\时 3\时 3\时 = 126(方法,建筑,坚守的城市,分辨率)配置,高分辨率细胞上的SAR,BSM和CrossEarth测试,为158 158 LOCO测试细胞,每组150幅图像. 建筑细节、预先训练的重量源和适应方法超参数载于附录F。 表2汇总了三个阻断点和两个分辨率的集合结果;每个细胞数和置信间隔载于附录G。 158个158个试验细胞中的157个157个在地理转移下显著降解(p < 0.05 p < 0.05,配对靴;在Bonferroni修正158个试验家族后151个,平均LOCO降解为−8.34-8.34 mIoU,最差的单细胞降解为−28.50-28.50 mIoU)。 数据缩放测试显示差距不是小数据效应:将LOCO训练集从225 225到900 900图像翻了两番,缩小了0.80 0.80 mIoU(95% 95% CI [0.46, 1.14] [0.46, 1.14]),从6.48 6.48 到5.50 5.50,每个细胞的上方有显著前缘,但有一个除外(高分辨率,三个种子;附录H.1 ). 表2中的两个结论对本文的其余部分产生了影响。 首先,一种适应方法的成本取决于结构:ISW在OGLANet上花费DINOv3 − 18.5-18.5 mIOU,在OGLANet上花费− 11.1 - 11.1,而MRFP + 成本在OGLANet上花费-14.0 - 14.0,在DINov3上花费− 4.9 - 4.9. 第二,没有一种适应方法是完全安全的:8种适应方法中有6种平均降解比香草多(5种显著,Holm p < 0.05 p < 0.05),除了SegDeSiC以外,每一种方法都会降解所有四种结构上被评价的每个细胞。 在无法进入目标城市的情况下,表2没有为从业人员选择适应方法提供依据。 第4节问,在结构中,失败在哪里存在,为什么统一校正不能统一。

blocks.en: Table 2 showed that no adaptation method is uniformly safe across architectures, suggesting the failure is not a single mechanism a single correction can address. Yet the gap is consistent enough within each architecture that we can ask where in the model it lives. We answer this with three controlled interventions on the LOCO models from Table 2 , ordered by what a practitioner would try first. Section 4.2 tests the cheapest possible fix: aligning pixel statistics across cities, ruling in or out a whole class of preprocessing-based recoveries. Section 4.3 then asks whether the model’s outputs are still usable under a confidence threshold, since deployed systems consume thresholded predictions rather than raw probabilities. Section 4.4 localizes which component of each architecture carries the failure. Figure 2 grounds what we are explaining: under LOCO, models keep spatial localization but lose foreground-class confidence: sharp upper-bound predictions become washed-out heatmaps over true shadow regions, not hallucinated shadow elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,没有任何一种适应方法在各种结构中是统一安全的,这表明失败不是一个单一的纠正机制。 然而,在每个架构中,这种差距是完全一致的,我们可以问它所生活的模式在哪里。 我们用表2对LOCO模型的3个有控制的干预来回答这个问题。 第4.2节测试了尽可能便宜的固定方法:调整各城市的像素统计,排除或排除了一整套基于预处理的回收。 然后,第4.3节询问该模型的输出是否仍可在置信阈值下使用,因为所部署的系统消耗了阈值预测,而不是原始概率。 第4.4节将每个建筑的哪些部分带有故障的地方化。 图2说明了我们所解释的理由:在LOCO下,模型保持空间定位,但丧失了前景级的信心:尖锐的上限预测变成冲出真实阴影区域的热图,而不是在其他地方产生幻影。

blocks.en: 4.2 Failure operates in feature space, not pixel space
blocks.zh: 4.2 失败运行在特征空间,而不是像素空间

blocks.en: Test design. If the LOCO failure were a pixel-statistics shortcut, aligning the test image’s pixel histogram to the training-city distribution should at least partially recover the gap. We test this directly. For each (architecture, holdout city) pair under vanilla LOCO, we compute the aggregate intensity histogram (the mean of the three channels) of the source-city training images. We map each test image’s intensity CDF onto this histogram, restore each pixel’s ratio between its channels and its intensity, and run inference with the trained model unchanged.
blocks.zh: 测试设计. 如果 LOCO 失败是像素- 统计学的快捷键, 测试图像的像素直方图与训练- 城市分布相匹配至少应该部分恢复差距 。 我们直接测试一下 对于香草LOCO下的每一对(architecture, holdout city),我们计算出源城训练图像的总强度直方图(三个通道的平均值). 我们把每个测试图像的强度 CDF 映射到这个直方图上, 恢复每个像素在它的通道和强度之间的比例, 用训练有素的模型进行推论。

blocks.en: Result. Histogram matching makes things worse, uniformly. Across the 9 9 vanilla LOCO cells, mean mIoU drops by 0.45 0.45 relative to LOCO itself (paired bootstrap 95 % 95\% CI [ − 0.523 , − 0.380 ] [-0.523,-0.380] , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ); not a single cell improves. To put the magnitude on a scale, we use the per-image recovery ratio R i = IoU i match − IoU i LOCO IoU i upper − IoU i LOCO R_{i}=\frac{\text{IoU}_{i}^{\text{match}}-\text{IoU}_{i}^{\text{LOCO}}}{\text{IoU}_{i}^{\text{upper}}-\text{IoU}_{i}^{\text{LOCO}}} where R = 1 R=1 means full recovery; R = 0 R=0 means no change from LOCO; R < 0 R<0 means the intervention is worse than doing nothing. Per-architecture medians fall in [ − 2.72 , − 1.55 ] [-2.72,-1.55] , with all 95 % 95\% CIs excluding zero: at the median, matched images lie 2.5 2.5 to 3.7 3.7 times as far from the upper bound as LOCO itself. The same rule improves none of 27 27 vanilla LOCO models trained on 225 225 , 450 450 or 900 900 images (three architectures, high resolution; Appendix H.1 ).

blocks.en: Training-time appearance augmentation. We also retrain both the LOCO model and its upper bound with appearance-only augmentation (colour, illumination, contrast, blur, noise; geometry preserved) on the 9 9 high-resolution (architecture, held-out city) cells. Retraining with a different random seed alone moves a cell’s gap: across three vanilla seeds, the standard deviation of the gap ranges from 0.24 0.24 to 4.26 4.26 mIoU between cells. Before training the augmented models, we therefore set each cell’s threshold at twice this standard deviation and count a gap as changed only if augmentation moves it by more. Six of nine gaps do not change. The mean gap moves from − 6.04 -6.04 to − 4.11 -4.11 mIoU, with OGLANet/Phoenix and DINOv3/Phoenix narrowing and DINOv3/Miami widening. Phoenix also has the largest seed variance of the three cities, and three cities cannot separate a Phoenix-specific appearance effect from that variance (Appendix H.2 ).
blocks.zh: 培训时间增加。 我们还在9个高分辨率(architecture, hold-out city)细胞上重新训练LOCO模型及其上部仅以外观增强(颜色,照明,对比,模糊,噪音;几何保存). 单用不同的随机种子进行再训练会移动细胞的间隙:跨越三个香草种子,间隙的标准差从0.24 0.24到4.26 4.26 mIoU. 因此,在训练增强型号之前,我们将每个单元格的阈值设定在标准偏差的两倍,并且只有在增强型移动更多时,才算作一个变化的缺口。 九空中六不变化. 平均差距从−6.04-6.04升至−4.11-4.11毫升,OGLANet/Phoenix和DINov3/Phoenix缩小,DINov3/Miami扩大。 凤凰城也有三大城市最大的种子差异,三个城市无法将凤凰城特有的外观效应与该差异区分开来(附录H.2.

blocks.en: Implication. Geographic transfer failure is not a pixel-level shortcut. The features the LOCO model relies on encode the joint distribution of intensity, texture, and spatial pattern in source-city imagery. Aligning the marginal pixel histogram alone breaks this coupling without replacing it with anything useful. This rules out a whole class of cheap fixes a practitioner might try first (like gamma correction, contrast normalization, single-channel histogram standardization) and tells us any successful intervention has to operate at the feature level.
blocks.zh: 释义. 地理传输失败不是像素级快捷键. LOCO模型的特征依赖于编码源城图像中强度、纹理和空间模式的联合分布。 仅对齐边形像素直方图就打破了这种耦合,而不用任何有用的东西来取代它. 这排除了一整类廉价的修补方法,从业者可能先尝试(如伽玛校正,对比常态,单通道直径标准化),并告诉我们任何成功的干预都必须在特征层面操作.

blocks.en: 4.3 Class-asymmetric selective-prediction failure
blocks.zh: 4.3 类不对称选择性预测性故障

blocks.en: Test design. A practitioner deploying segmentation under domain shift consumes confidence-thresholded predictions, not raw outputs. The relevant question is therefore not the average error but how the threshold-conditioned error rate degrades under shift. The selective-prediction (SP) framework [ 30 , 31 , 32 ] measures threshold-conditioned error: per image, sort pixels by confidence and compute the cumulative error rate at each coverage level c ∈ { 0.10 , 0.15 , … , 1.00 } c\in\{0.10,0.15,\ldots,1.00\} . The Area Under the Risk-Coverage curve (AURC) integrates this curve. The SP gap = AURC LOCO {}_{\text{LOCO}} − - AURC upper {}_{\text{upper}} measures how much threshold-conditioned error rises under transfer; a gap of zero means selective deployment recovers within-city quality. We compute the gap on three pixel populations: the foreground class (GT-shadow, confidence = p =p ), the background class (GT-background, confidence = 1 − p =1{-}p ), and all pixels (confidence = max ⁡ ( p , 1 − p ) =\max(p,1{-}p) ). All numbers in this subsection come from the 63 63 LOCO cells (architecture × \times method × \times holdout city, for high-resolution); paired image-level bootstrap ( B = 1,000 B=1{,}000 ) gives 95 % 95\% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 测试设计. 在域位转移下部署分化的从业者会消耗信心阈值的预测,而不是原始产出. 因此,相关问题不是平均误差,而是阈值条件误差率如何在轮班时降解。 选择性预测(SP)框架 [30, 31, 32] 测量阈值条件错误:每个图像,通过置信排序像素,并计算每个覆盖级别 c { { 0.10, 0.15,..., 1.00} c\in\ 0.10, 0.15,\ldots, 1.00}的累积错误率. 风险-overage曲线下的区域(AURC)整合了这一曲线. SP差距 = AURC LOCO QQText{LOCO}}} - AURC 上QQText{upper}}} 测量在转移中有多少阈值条件错误上升;零差距意味着选择性部署恢复城市内部的质量. 我们在三个像素群上计算空隙:前景类(GT-shadow,置信=p=p),背景类(GT-background,置信=1−p=1{}p),以及所有像素(自信=最大_________________(p, 1{}p) +max(p, 1{}) 。本小节中的所有数字都来自63个LOCO细胞(architecture ××\times method ×\time holdout city,用于高分辨率);配对图像级靴子(B=1000 B=1{,}000)给出95%的95= 置信间隔 。

blocks.en: The gap concentrates on the foreground class. On shadow pixels the gap averages + 0.136 +0.136 across the 63 63 cells. On background pixels it averages + 0.006 +0.006 . The asymmetry is consistent across cells: the foreground gap exceeded the background gap in 55 55 of the 63 63 cells (sign-test p = 4.9 × 10 − 10 p=4.9\times 10^{-10} ). Two further measurements describe how the model’s confidence shifts. At the logit level, true-positive logits drop on average by 0.85 0.85 nats (the model becomes much less confident on its foreground predictions), while logits on false-positive predictions barely move ( − 0.15 -0.15 nats); the drop is larger on the true-positive side in 55 55 of 63 63 cells. Calibration error rises asymmetrically in the same direction (Appendix G.6 ). The LOCO failure is therefore not uniform confidence flattening: the model selectively loses commitment on the class it is trying to detect, while leaving its background commitment intact.
blocks.zh: 差距集中在前场课上. 在阴影像素上,63个63个细胞的间隙平均为+0.136+0.136. 在背景像素上,平均为+0.006+0.006. 非对称性在细胞间是一致的:在63个63个细胞中,有55个超过前缘差距(符号测试p=4.9×10−10p=4.9\times 10×10}). 还有两项测量说明模型的信心如何变化。 在对数水平上,真阳性对数平均下降0.85 0.85纳特(模型对其前缘预测的信心要小得多),而对假阳性预测的对数几乎没有移动(−0.15-0.15纳特);在63个细胞中的55个细胞中,真阳性对数的下降较大. 校准误差向同一方向不对称上升(附录G.6 ). 因此,LOCO的失败不是统一的信心平缓:模型有选择地失去了它试图发现的阶层的承诺,同时使其背景承诺保持不变。

blocks.en: Cross-task scope test on INRIA building footprints. A natural objection is that these patterns are properties of shadow appearance, not geographic transfer. We replicate the protocol on INRIA building extraction [ 33 ] , a dense-prediction task whose foreground is shape-defined rather than illumination-defined (MAMNet, holdout cities Austin/Chicago/Vienna, matched training recipe). The foreground SP gap and the foreground-vs-background asymmetry both transfer in direction across tasks (sign test at the strongest result the sample size permits, p = 0.016 p=0.016 each; Cohen’s d > 1.1 d>1.1 ), confirming the SP-gap signature is a property of LOCO across tasks rather than of shadows. Figure 3 (a) inset shows the gap distributions side by side.
blocks.zh: 跨任务范围测试INRIA建筑脚印. 一个自然的反对意见是这些模式是影子外观的属性,而不是地理转移. 我们复制关于INRIA建筑提取的协议[33],这是一项密集的预测性任务,其前景是形状界定而不是照明界定(MAMNet, Holdout city Austin/Chicago/Vienna, 匹配培训配方)。 前景SP的缺口和前景-vs-背景不对称都是在跨任务方向上转移(最强结果的签名测试样本大小允许,p = 0.016 p = 0.016;Cohen的d > 1.1 d>1.1),确认SP-gap的签名是LOCO跨越任务而不是阴影的财产. 图3(a)同时显示差距分布。

blocks.en: A recoverable threshold exists. The selective-prediction framing is only useful if there is some confidence threshold at which LOCO predictions match within-city quality. We find one in 59 59 of 63 63 cells; the four exceptions are all on Phoenix, the most distant holdout, under the most aggressive adaptation methods. This makes coverage thresholding, rather than post-hoc temperature scaling, the natural label-free recovery recipe under geographic shift, and Section 5 builds on it directly. Method-ranking stability across architectures, the post-hoc temperature-scaling alternative, and per-cell threshold values are in Appendix G.6 .
blocks.zh: 存在可回收阈值。 选择性的预测框架只有在有某种信心阈值,使当地办事处的预测符合城市内部的质量时才有用。 我们发现在63个细胞中,有59个59个细胞有1个;四个例外都发生在凤凰城,这是最遥远的阻力,采用最积极的改造方法。 这使得覆盖阈值在地理变化下自然无标签的恢复食谱,而不是热度后温度缩放,第5节直接以此为基础。 跨架构的方法级稳定性,加热温度缩放后的替代品,以及每个细胞的阈值在附录G.6中.

blocks.en: Implication. The SP gap is large, foreground-concentrated, hidden by 0 / 1 0/1 evaluation, recoverable by coverage thresholding, and consistent across architectures and across a second dense-prediction task. Section 4.4 asks where in the architecture the failure that produces this gap actually lives.
blocks.zh: 释义. SP差距很大,前缘集中,由0/1 0/1评价隐藏,通过覆盖阈值可以恢复,并贯穿各个架构和第二个密集预测任务。 第4.4节询问造成这一差距的失败在结构中实际存在在何处。

blocks.en: 4.4 Architecture-dependent failure locus
blocks.zh: 4.4 依赖结构的故障点

blocks.en: Sections 4.2 and 4.3 established that the failure is in feature space and that confidence collapses asymmetrically. Neither result tells us which part of a given model produces the collapse: the encoder, the decoder, or both. This matters because uniform feature-level corrections (ISW whitens, MRFP + randomizes) act on a fixed locus, and Table 2 already showed they fail catastrophically on some architectures while helping others. If different architectures carry the failure in different components, that asymmetry is the explanation.
blocks.zh: 第4.2节和第4.3节规定,故障位于地貌空间,信任不对称地崩溃。 没有结果告诉我们一个给定模型的哪一部分产生崩溃:编码器,解码器,或者两者兼而有之. 这很重要,因为统一的特征级校正(ISW whitens,MRFP + 随机化)在固定的蝗体上作用,而表2已经显示它们在某些架构上灾难性的失败,同时帮助其他架构. 如果不同的架构在不同的组件中承载失败,那么这种不对称就是解释.

blocks.en: Test design. We localise the failure by targeted retraining. Experiment A freezes the LOCO-trained encoder, reinitializes the decoder, and retrains only the decoder on 25 % 25\% of the holdout-city training set. Experiment B does the inverse: freezes the decoder, resets the encoder to its pretrained initialization, and retrains only the encoder on the same subset. If a component carries the failure, retraining it on a small target sample should recover most of the within-city gap; retraining the other component should not. Recovery is measured by the per-image ratio R R defined earlier (training details in Appendix G.8 ).
blocks.zh: 测试设计. 我们通过针对性的再培训,使失败发生地方化。 实验 冻结了LOCO训练的编码器,重新启动解码器,并在25 % 的阻滞城市训练集中重新打开解码器。 实验 B做反调:将解码器冻结,将编码器重置到其预先训练的初始化,仅在同一个子集上重排编码器. 如果某一部件带有故障,则在小型目标样本上进行再培训应能够弥补大部分城市内部的差距;再培训则不应涉及其他部件。 回收量按先前定义的RR(附录G.8中的培训细节)按人造图像比率计量。

blocks.en: Mirror-image recovery pattern. Decoder retraining (Experiment A) recovers DINOv3 ( R = 0.69 R=0.69 ) and MAMNet ( R = 0.67 R=0.67 ) but barely moves OGLANet ( R = 0.12 R=0.12 , [ 0.05 , 0.21 ] [0.05,0.21] - CI excludes meaningful recovery). Encoder retraining (Experiment B) shows the opposite pattern: it makes DINOv3 worse than LOCO ( R = − 0.13 R=-0.13 ), while recovering both CNNs ( R = 0.88 R=0.88 MAMNet, R = 0.86 R=0.86 OGLANet). All CIs in Appendix G.8 . The DINOv3-vs-OGLANet sign reversal across the two experiments shows decoder works for one, encoder works for the other, and each architecture is harmed by the other’s fix. This is the central evidence that the failure component is architecture-dependent. Figure 3 (c) shows the pattern.
blocks.zh: 镜像复原模式. 解码器再培训(实验A)恢复了DINOv3(R = 0.69 R = 0.69)和MAMNet(R = 0.67 R = 0.67),但很少移动OGLANet(R = 0.12 R = 0.12, [0.05, 0.21] - CI排除有意义的恢复)。 编码器再培训(Experiment B)显示了相反的模式:它使DINOv3比LOCO差(R=−0.13 R=-0.13),同时恢复了两种CNN(R=0.88 R=0.88 MAMNet,R=0.86 R=0.86 OGLANet). 附录G.8中的所有关键信息。 DINov3-vs-OGLANet标志在两个实验间反转显示解码器工作为一,编码器工作为二,每个建筑都受到二人固定的伤害. 这是失败组件依赖架构的核心证据. 图3(c)显示了模式。

blocks.en: Frozen encoder. If the gap came only from fine-tuning the encoder on two source cities, freezing the encoder would remove it. With the DINOv3 encoder frozen and only the decoder trained, the upper bound still exceeds LOCO by 7.10 7.10 , 2.67 2.67 and 2.75 2.75 mIoU on Chicago, Miami and Phoenix (each significant after Holm correction over the three cities; Appendix H.3 ). Both models share the frozen encoder, so this gap arises in the decoder, consistent with the locus Experiment A measures for DINOv3.
blocks.zh: 冰冻编码器. 如果空隙只来自两个源城市的编码器的微调,那么冻结编码器就会将其移除. 由于DINOv3编码器被冻结,而且只有解码器经过训练,上方的编码仍比LOCO多7.107.10,2.672.67和2.752.75mIoU在芝加哥,迈阿密和凤凰城(在霍尔姆对三座城市进行校正后,每条编码器都具有重大意义;附录H.3). 两种模型都共享冷冻编码器,因此这个漏洞出现在解码器中,与DINov3的蝗体实验A措施一致.

blocks.en: Pretraining and fine-tuning regime. DINOv3 also differs from the CNNs in self-supervised pretraining and a low fine-tuning learning rate. We test both on MAMNet with a ResNet-50 encoder by training four versions: ImageNet-supervised or self-supervised DINO pretraining, each fine-tuned at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} or 10 − 5 10^{-5} (three held-out cities, three seeds each). Encoder retraining recovers all four versions (median R R 0.80 0.80 to 0.87 0.87 , 95 % 95\% CIs within [ 0.76 , 0.90 ] [0.76,0.90] ), against − 0.13 -0.13 for DINOv3. The self-supervised, low-learning-rate version recovers less than the supervised, high-learning-rate one (mean per-image difference − 0.13 -0.13 , 95 % 95\% CI [ − 0.22 , − 0.05 ] [-0.22,-0.05] , Holm p = 0.005 p=0.005 ), and its recoverable component stays in the encoder. Pretraining scale remains confounded: DINO-ResNet-50 is pretrained on ImageNet-1k ( 1.28 1.28 M images) and DINOv3 on LVD-1689M (Appendix H.4 ).
blocks.zh: 预先培训和微调制度。 DINov3在自我监督的预训和低微调的学习率方面也与CNN不同. 我们用ResNet-50编码器在MAMNet上进行测试,培训了四个版本: ImageNet - 监督或自我监督的DINO预训,每集以学习率10−4 10−4}或10−5 10−5}(三个被搁置的城市,每个有3个种子)进行微调. 编码器再培训回收了所有四种版本(中间号R 0.80 0.80至0.87 0.87, 95% 95% CI在[0.76, 0.90] [0.76, 0.90] 之内),而DINOv3为−0.13-0.13。 自我监督的低学习率版本恢复率低于被监督的高学习率版本(平均人均图像差−0.13-0.13,95% 95\% CI [−0.22,−0.05],Holm p = 0.005 p = 0.005),其可回收组件留在编码器中. Pretraining system仍然令人困惑:DINO-ResNet-50在ImageNet-1k(1.28 1.28 M图像)和LVD-1689M(附录H.4)上的DINov3上预训.

blocks.en: Implication. The recoverable component is architecture-dependent: decoder for DINOv3, encoder for OGLANet, both for MAMNet. This directly explains the catastrophic failures in Table 2 . MRFP + perturbs encoder features uniformly without targeting OGLANet’s encoder-locus failure, so it costs OGLANet − 14.0 -14.0 mIoU. ISW whitens features in a way that corrupts the representation DINOv3 depends on, so it costs DINOv3 − 18.5 -18.5 mIoU.
blocks.zh: 释义. 可回收组件依赖架构:DINov3的解码器,OGLANet的编码器,两者都用于MAMNet. 这直接解释了表2中的灾难性失败。 MRFP + 扰动编码器的特性统一而不针对 OGLANet 的编码器-locus 故障,所以它花费了 OGLANet − 14.0 - 14.0 mIoU 。 ISW 的白化特性会腐蚀DINov3 所依赖的代表性,所以它花费了 DINov3 − 18.5 - 18.5 mIoU 。

blocks.en: 4.5 External benchmark: S-EO
blocks.zh: 4.5 外部基准: 道德操守办公室

blocks.en: We repeat the benchmark and the three probes on S-EO [ 4 ] : WorldView-3 imagery of Omaha, Jacksonville and San Diego, four architectures, three seeds, and 3,500 3{,}500 training patches per side (Appendix I ). Its masks are derived from digital surface models; both sides of every gap share them, so label noise largely cancels in the gap. The upper bound exceeds LOCO in all 12 12 (architecture, held-out city) pairs (Holm p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), by 2.10 2.10 to 7.95 7.95 mIoU and 5.41 5.41 [ 5.07 , 5.75 ] [5.07,5.75] pooled. Histogram matching lowers mIoU in all 36 36 vanilla cells, each significant after Holm correction, and the foreground AURC gap exceeds the background gap in all 12 12 pairs, significantly in 8 8 . Decoder retraining raises foreground IoU in all 18 18 MAMNet and DINOv3 cells and lowers it in all 9 9 OGLANet cells; the size of this change tracks the gap of the LOCO model whose decoder is retrained ( R 2 = 0.62 R^{2}=0.62 ), while its sign separates by architecture even between DINOv3 and OGLANet models with similar gaps. The background probability also shifts under LOCO in 10 10 of 12 12 pairs, so on S-EO the confidence change is not confined to the shadow class. The gap shows no dependence on the sun-elevation distance between test patches and training scenes (cluster-robust p = 0.30 p=0.30 , three cities).
blocks.zh: 我们重复基准 和三个探测器 在S-EO [4]: WorldView-3的奥马哈,杰克逊维尔和圣迭戈的图像,四个建筑,三个种子,每个侧面3500 3{,}500个训练补丁(附录一). 其口罩来源于数字表面模型;每个缺口的两侧都共享,因此标签噪声在缺口中基本取消. 在全部12个12个城市(建筑、被扣留城市)中,上限值超过LOCO(Holm p < 0.05 p < 0.05)的2.10 2.10至7.95 mIoU和5.41 5.41 [5.07, 5.75] [5.07,5.75] 集合值。 在全部36个36个香草细胞中,直方图匹配下位数mIoU,在Holm校正后各显著,前方AURC缺口超过所有12对中的背景缺口,在8对8中显著. 解码器再培训在全部18个MAMNet和DINOv3细胞中提高前置IoU,并在全部9个OGLANet细胞中降低;这一变化的大小跟踪了LOCO模型的缺口,其解码器被重新训练(R 2 = 0.62 R^{2}=0.62),而其标志通过建筑来分离,甚至在DINOv3和OGLANet模型之间也有类似的缺口. 在LOCO下,背景概率也在12对中的10对10中转移,因此在S-EO上,置信率的变化并不局限于阴影类. 差距显示测试补丁与训练场景之间没有依赖日照距离(集群-robust p=0.30 p=0.30,三座城市).

blocks.en: 5 Case Study: Spectral Information Bottleneck (SIB)
blocks.zh: 5 案例研究:光谱信息Bottleneck(SIB)

blocks.en: Section 4 characterized three failure modes under geographic transfer. We now ask whether this characterization translates into design guidance. We present SIB , a plug-in module that maps each finding to a specific design choice. SIB has the smallest mean gap to the within-city upper bound of the ten methods we evaluate, level with FDA. SIB is designed from the same LOCO cells on which we evaluate it, so its results show that the diagnosis yields a usable design and do not test the diagnosis independently.
blocks.zh: 第4节说明了地域转移的三种失败模式。 我们现在问,这种定性是否转化为设计指导。 我们介绍SIB,一个插件模块,将每个发现都映射到特定的设计选择. SIB对于我们评价的十种方法, 与FDA相比, 城市内部的上限差距最小。 SIB是用我们评价的LOCO细胞设计的,因此它的结果显示,诊断产生一个可用的设计,而不是独立测试诊断.

blocks.en: 5.1 Module design
blocks.zh: 5.1 模块设计

blocks.en: Feature-space failure (§ 4.2 ) → \rightarrow band-asymmetric compression. Based on 4.2 , the intervention must operate on feature space. We need to compress domain-specific content while preserving boundary detail. Haar wavelet decomposition gives this separation directly: the low-frequency subband F L ​ L F_{LL} carries surface appearance and city-specific texture; the high-frequency subbands F L ​ H , F H ​ L , F H ​ H F_{LH},F_{HL},F_{HH} carry shadow geometry. Recent VFM-based domain generalization work confirms this content/style separation in feature space [ 26 ] . We apply a variational information bottleneck [ 34 ] to F L ​ L F_{LL} aggressively and to F L ​ H , F H ​ L F_{LH},F_{HL} gently. F H ​ H F_{HH} passes through. Aggressive compression on F L ​ L F_{LL} removes city-specific content, while gentle compression on the boundary subbands prevents the bottleneck from erasing the edge structure shadow detection requires.
blocks.zh: 特性- 空间失败( §4.2) →\ 右旋带- 非对称压缩 。 根据4.2,干预必须在地物空间上进行。 我们需要在保留边界细节的同时压缩特定域的内容. Haar波列分解直接使这种分离:低频子波段F L L QQLL}携带表面外观和特定城市的纹理;高频子波段F L H,F H FQLH},FQQHL}携带阴影几何. 最近基于VFM的域泛化工作证实了这种内容/风格在特征空间中的分离[26]. 我们积极地对F L L L FQLL] 和F L H 、 F H L , 轻轻地使用变异性的信息瓶颈。 FL L FQQLL}的主动压缩可以去除城市特有的内容,而边界子带的温和压缩可以防止瓶颈擦除边缘结构阴影检测需要.

blocks.en: Architecture-dependent locus (§ 4.4 ) → \rightarrow skip gates and CNN-only preprocessing. The bottleneck acts on encoder output. In U-Net, skip connections route encoder features directly to the decoder, bypassing the bottleneck. We add Skip Attention Gates: channel-wise sigmoid gates on each skip, identity-initialized so they default to a no-op. The model learns to suppress city-specific channels routed around the bottleneck. CNN encoders also absorb pre-encoder pixel statistics no feature-level intervention can reach. We add Fourier Domain Adaptation [ 20 ] as input preprocessing on the CNN branch only. ViT encoders carry their recoverable component in the decoder (§ 4.4 ) and receive neither component.
blocks.zh: 依赖建筑的蝗虫(§4.4)_\右转跳闸和CNN只进行预处理. 瓶颈作用于编码器输出. 在U-Net中,跳过连接路由编码器的特性直接到解码器,绕过瓶颈. 我们添加了跳过注意门:每个跳过时的通道的sigmoid门, 身份初始化,所以它们默认为不开放。 该模型学习抑制绕过瓶颈的市区特定频道. CNN编码器还吸收了任何特性级干预都无法达到的预编码像素统计. 我们加入了Fourier域名适应[20] 仅作为CNN分支的输入预处理. ViT编码器在解码器中携带其可回收组件(§4.4),并接收两个组件.

blocks.en: Class-asymmetric SP failure (§ 4.3 ) → \rightarrow coverage thresholding. The model’s confidence ranking survives geographic shift even when calibration fails. We exploit the surviving ranking with a deployment-time recipe: per cell, fit c v ​ a ​ l ∗ c^{*}_{val} as the largest c c (coverage) at which selective shadow error on the source-city validation split is at most ( 1 − τ ) ⋅ err v ​ a ​ l ​ ( c = 1.0 ) (1-\tau)\cdot\text{err}_{val}(c{=}1.0) , with τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 fixed globally, i.e., the criterion is to halve the source-val full-coverage error. Apply c v ​ a ​ l ∗ c^{*}_{val} at deployment on the held-out city. The procedure uses no held-out labels. Rank preservation guarantees per-image selective error is bounded by full-coverage error, so the population test measures the magnitude of the recovery rather than its direction. Training loss and full hyperparameters in Appendix J .
blocks.zh: 类不对称的SP故障(第4.3节) ^\右旋覆盖阈值. 即使校准失败,该模型的信心排名也会持续到地理转变。 我们用部署时间的配方来利用幸存的排名:每个单元格,适合 c v a l → * c^{*}_{val}作为最大的c c (覆盖),其中源–城市验证拆分的选择性阴影误差最多(1~\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 在被搁置的城市部署时应用 c v a l * * c^{*}_{val 。 该程序使用不挂标签。 排名保值保证每幅图像选择性误差以全覆盖误差为界,因此人口测试测量恢复的幅度而不是其方向. 附录J中的训练损失和全高参数。

blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We introduced ShadowTransfer , a 4,500 4{,}500 -image human-verified benchmark for geographic transfer in overhead shadow detection across three U.S. cities and two native resolutions, with a leave-one-city-out protocol and paired bootstrap reporting. Its three-probe framework indicates that the failure operates in feature space (Section 4.2 ), appears as a class-asymmetric collapse of foreground confidence that 0 / 1 0/1 metrics under-report by 2.3 × 2.3\times (Section 4.3 ), and is recoverable through an architecture-dependent component: decoder for DINOv3, encoder for OGLANet, both for MAMNet (Section 4.4 ). Four of five selective-prediction findings replicate on INRIA building footprints. The gap remains significant in every 900 900 -image cell and on the external S-EO benchmark. As a case study, SIB has the smallest mean gap of the ten methods we evaluate ( 6.42 6.42 mIoU), level with FDA.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Shadow Transfer(Shadow Transfer), 4,500 4{,}500 - 图像的人验证基准, 其三假构框架表明,故障在特征空间中运行(第4.2节),似乎是前缘信心的类不对称崩溃,即0/1 0/1 公尺低于2.3×2.3\时(第4.3节),并且可通过结构依赖的组件加以恢复:DINov3的解码器,OGLANET的编码器,两者都用于MAMNet(第4.4节)。 五个有选择性的预测结论中有四个在INRIA建筑脚印上复制. 每900-900个图像单元和外部的S-EO基准中,差距仍然很大。 作为案例研究,SIB在我们评价的十种方法(6.42 6.42 mIoU)中,与FDA的级别差距最小.

blocks.en: The benchmark covers three U.S. cities, RGB-only NAIP imagery, a single fall season, and four architectures. Non-grid morphologies, multispectral sensors, and untested architectures (e.g., SegFormer) remain open. We characterize where the failure occurs, how it distorts predictions, and which component recovers it, but do not isolate a causal mechanism that connects these characterizations. DINOv3’s decoder locus also cannot be attributed to its ViT architecture alone, since no CNN in our tests matches its pretraining scale. We release ShadowTransfer , the LOCO splits, training code, and trained models as an evaluation instrument to be read with the three probes: its LOCO gaps measure geographic transfer risk in overhead dense prediction, and its two native resolutions support diagnosis of cross-resolution transfer failure. Together, the benchmark and framework give the field a shared instrument for the question that matters at deployment: not just whether a model works, but where and on which class it will fail when the city changes.
blocks.zh: 该基准覆盖了美国三个城市,只有RGB的NAIP图像,一个单一的秋季季,以及四个建筑. 非网格形态,多光谱传感器,以及未经测试的架构(如SegFormer)仍然开放. 我们描述失败发生在何处,它如何扭曲预测,以及哪个部分恢复它,但不孤立连接这些特征的因果关系机制. DINov3的解码器蝗虫不能仅仅归结于它的Vit架构, 我们发布了Shadow Transfer, LOCO拆分,训练代码,以及训练过的模型作为评估工具与三个探测器一起阅读:它的 LOCO差距测量了在高空密度预测中的地理转移风险,它的两个本土分辨率支持对跨分辨率转移失败的诊断. 基准和框架共同给予外地一个共同的工具,用于处理部署时重要的问题:不仅模型是否可行,而且当城市改变时,模型将在哪个类别和哪个类别上失败。

blocks.en:
Purpose. ShadowTransfer was created to enable measurement of
geographic transfer in overhead shadow detection. No existing overhead shadow
dataset combines human-verified labels, multiple cities, native multi-resolution
coverage, and a defined cross-city evaluation protocol (Table 1 );
the most recent overhead-shadow survey [ 19 ] identifies
cross-dataset generalization as an open problem. Creators and funding. Shagun Mittal, Raymond A. Yeh and Satish Ukkusuri (Purdue University). The work received no external funding; compute was provided through ACCESS allocation CIS260282.

blocks.en: A.5 Uses
blocks.zh: A.5 用途

blocks.en:
Primary use. Benchmarking shadow detection on overhead aerial imagery,
with explicit measurement of geographic transfer (LOCO) and in-domain performance
per city. Already used for. Baseline, diagnostic, and case-study results in this
paper, including cross-task replication on INRIA building footprints
(§ 4.3 , App. G.7 ). Other suggested uses. Building footprint and façade extraction
(occlusion priors), shadow-removal research, domain generalization for dense
prediction, and urban-morphology or solar-geometry analysis from the released
coordinates and shadow-type labels. Uses not supported. Generalization beyond grid-pattern North American
urbanism, beyond NAIP RGB sensor characteristics, or across seasons (the dataset
captures a single fall window) is not supported. The 0.3 m/px and 0.6 m/px
subsets are separate native acquisitions; users studying resolution transfer
should not synthesize one from the other.

blocks.en: B.1 Three-Phase Pipeline
blocks.zh: B.1 三阶段管道

blocks.en:
Seven trained annotators produced shadow masks in CVAT across 45 45 sessions of 105 105 images each ( 100 100 working images + + 5 5 gold images with frozen reference masks; § B.2 ). Sessions
proceed in three sequential phases (Figure 5 ); each
phase’s output seeds the next.

Phase 1: SAM-assisted manual labeling. Annotators draw shadow
masks on raw 384 × 384 384{\times}384 patches. The CVAT AI Interactor [ 37 ] , powered
by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 38 ] , proposes a
candidate boundary from a single annotator click; the annotator
accepts, refines, or rejects it. Manual polygon drawing is available
for thin-linear and irregular shadows where SAM under-segments. Each
segment receives a shadow-type label from the six-category taxonomy
(§ C.1 ). Phase 1 spans the first 10 10 sessions and
is restricted to Chicago and Miami imagery balanced across the two
native resolutions; Phoenix is admitted only after the label
distribution stabilizes (gold-image κ ≥ 0.7 \kappa\geq 0.7 for a
majority of annotators). Mean throughput is 4.8 minutes per
image after a one-session per-annotator ramp-up.

blocks.en:
Phase 2: Model-in-the-loop acceleration. After Phase 1, all
labels train an interim shadow detector. The detector is one of
{MAMNet, OGLANet, DINOv3}, drawn at random for each new 100 100 -image
batch; rotating architectures limits annotator entrainment to any
single model’s failure modes. Predictions from the interim model are
loaded into CVAT as the starting layer; annotators delete false
positives, refine boundaries, and add missed segments rather than
redraw from scratch. The interim model is retrained at session
boundaries on the cumulative labeled corpus. Throughput rises to 75 75 seconds per image, a ∼ 4 × \sim\!4\times acceleration over
Phase 1.

blocks.en:
Phase 3: Retroactive quality control. After all working
sessions complete, a final shadow detector is trained on the full
Phase 1 + + 2 corpus and used to revisit every annotated segment. For
each image we compute the per-segment Intersection-over-Union (IoU)
between each human annotation j j and each model prediction i i . Each
(annotation, prediction) pair receives one of four statuses
(Table 4 ). Statuses are color-coded in CVAT so
annotators triage at a glance: green segments are skipped; yellow,
blue, and red segments are routed to a second annotator pass for
adjudication. The status taxonomy is released with the dataset for
downstream provenance analyses; for the LOCO benchmark
(§ 3.3 ), all final segments are merged into the binary
foreground class regardless of their adjudication route.

blocks.en: C.1 Shadow Taxonomy
blocks.zh: C.1 影子分类学

blocks.en:
Each annotated shadow segment carries one of six type labels. The taxonomy
is released with the dataset for downstream analyses; the LOCO benchmark
(§ 3.3 ) collapses these to a binary mask. Definitions and
inclusion rules are in Table 6 . Annotators applied a
single inclusion rule across all six types: a region is shadow if it is
solar-directional and consistent with local scene geometry. Sensor
artifacts, dark water, and cloud shadows lacking geometric consistency are
excluded.

blocks.en: C.3 Spatial Sampling Protocol
blocks.zh: C.3 空间取样议定书

blocks.en: Patches are drawn from NAIP orthoimagery in two streams: random patches that provide diverse independent samples, and paired patches that share ground coordinates across the two native resolutions.
blocks.zh: 补丁从两个溪流中的NAIP整形图画中抽取:随机补丁提供不同的独立样本,和配对补丁,在两个原生分辨率之间共享地面坐标.

blocks.en:
Random patches. Within each (city, resolution) pair, target patch counts are distributed
across NAIP tiles overlapping the city administrative boundary. If the
target count is at most the tile count, tiles are sampled without
replacement and each sampled tile contributes one patch; otherwise the
count is distributed evenly with the remainder allocated to randomly
chosen tiles. Within each selected tile, a candidate center is sampled
uniformly inside the tile geometry and accepted only if (i) the point
lies within the city boundary and (ii) a 384 × 384 384{\times}384 window centered
at the point fits entirely inside the tile (a 192 192 -pixel buffer to all
edges). Up to 50 50 candidates are tried per slot; unfilled slots are
skipped. The one-patch-per-tile rule limits spatial autocorrelation
between samples.

blocks.en: Appendix D Split Distribution Characterization
blocks.zh: 附录D 拆分分布特征

blocks.en: Overhead remote-sensing benchmarks rarely verify that train, validation, and test splits are distributionally matched within each domain, despite documented evidence that within-domain spatial autocorrelation can inflate apparent performance by up to 28 % 28\% [ 41 ] . We close this gap for ShadowTransfer with two complementary diagnostic suites: omnibus feature-space tests that ask whether the splits are distinguishable at all (§ D.1 ), and a task-relevant feature panel that localizes any divergence to interpretable axes (§ D.2 ). The diagnostics confirm that the LOCO Upper Bound measures within-city generalization rather than within-city heterogeneity, and they isolate one bounded caveat (§ D.3 ) for transparent reporting.
blocks.zh: 超前遥感基准很少核实列车、验证和测试裂解在各域内分布匹配,尽管有文件证明,域内空间自动连接可使表面性能降低28% 28% 。 [41]。 我们用两个互补的诊断套件弥补Shadow Transfer的这一缺口:一个是总括的特征空间测试,询问这些分裂是否完全可以区分(§D.1),另一个是与任务相关的特征面板,将任何差异定位到可解释轴(§D.2). 诊断结论证实,LOCO上界措施是城市内部的概括性措施,而不是城市内部的异质性,它们将一个有限度的警告(第D.3节)分离出来,用于透明的报告。

blocks.en: D.1 Omnibus Diagnostics
blocks.zh: D.1 综合诊断

blocks.en: For each of the six ⟨ \langle city, resolution ⟩ \rangle pairs we run four within-city tests comparing train against test. (D1) Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov on label statistics (per-image shadow coverage, blob count, mean blob area), reporting KS distance D D with image-level bootstrap CI ( B = 1,000 B{=}1{,}000 ); D > 0.15 D>0.15 at p < 0.05 p<0.05 flagged. (D2) Domain-classifier covariate-shift test: ImageNet ResNet-50 features feed a logistic regression trained to distinguish train from test images of the same city under 5 5 -fold cross-validation; ROC-AUC > 0.7 >0.7 flagged. (D3) Bootstrap maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) with RBF kernel under the median-heuristic bandwidth on DINOv2 features ( n = 200 n=200 per split, B = 1,000 B=1{,}000 ); p < 0.05 p<0.05 flagged. (D4) Spatial coverage: per-split longitude/latitude range, mean test-to-nearest-train distance, and KS on each coordinate.

blocks.en: Phoenix shows the cleanest splits of any city by every diagnostic. The single flagged cell, Chicago highres, traces to a structural property of the sampling protocol: test images come from the paired-coordinate subset (§ C.3 ), which can only be drawn from regions where NAIP provides overlapping coverage at both native resolutions. In Chicago that dual-coverage zone is geographically narrower than the random-train footprint (test latitudes start at 41.687 41.687 vs. 41.748 41.748 for train), producing the spatial concentration captured by D4 and propagating to the feature-space tests.

blocks.en: D.2 Per-Feature Divergence Panel
blocks.zh: D.2 千差万别小组

blocks.en: The omnibus suite answers whether train and test are distinguishable; for practitioners the more useful question is which task-relevant features are mismatched and by how much. We compute the train-vs-test KS distance separately on a panel of nine features that mechanically affect mIoU: shadow coverage fraction, blob count per image, mean blob area, small-object fraction, shadow-category mix (total variation in place of KS), and per-image mean intensity for each of R/G/B and the grayscale standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 总括套装解答了火车和测试是否可以区分;对于从业人员来说,更有用的问题是哪些与任务相关的特征不匹配,以及在多大程度上不匹配。 我们在由9个功能组成的板块上分别计算列车-vs测试KS距离,这些功能在机械上影响mIoU:阴影覆盖分量,每个图像的blob计数,平均blob面积,小对象分量,阴影类混合(取代KS的总变化),每个R/G/B的每个图像平均强度和灰度标准偏差.

blocks.en: The panel reproduces the omnibus picture at finer resolution and quantifies the size of the divergences. Chicago highres flags eight of nine features: shadow coverage shifts from 0.103 0.103 in train to 0.123 0.123 in test ( + 19 % +19\% relative), median blob area shifts by + 42 % +42\% , and blob count by + 18 % +18\% . These shifts are consistent with the dual-coverage geographic concentration documented above, the paired test footprint over-samples denser-shadow neighborhoods in central Chicago. Phoenix midres flags five features, but each at the threshold ( D ∈ [ 0.13 , 0.15 ] D\in[0.13,0.15] , relative shifts 2 2 – 5 % 5\% ), an order of magnitude smaller than the Chicago highres effect. Phoenix highres flags zero features and posts the lowest mean D D in the benchmark.
D.3 Implications for LOCO Reporting
blocks.zh: D.3 对当地办事处报告的影响

blocks.en: Two conclusions follow.
blocks.zh: 以下两个结论。

blocks.en: Phoenix’s LOCO degradation reflects cross-city transfer, not split heterogeneity. Phoenix’s within-city splits are statistically matched on every diagnostic, and the LOCO protocol does not draw on Phoenix’s training split when Phoenix is held out. Phoenix’s lower Upper Bound is partly mechanical: shadow coverage in Phoenix ( 5.7 5.7 – 6.7 % 6.7\% ) is roughly half that in Chicago/Miami ( 8.7 8.7 – 15.1 % 15.1\% ), the small-object fraction ( 0.80 0.80 – 0.82 0.82 vs. 0.41 0.41 – 0.50 0.50 ) is nearly twice as high, and mean R-channel intensity differs by ∼ 20 \sim 20 units (§ C.2 ). All three properties suppress mIoU regardless of model quality. The cross-city gap reported in Table 2 is therefore a genuine transfer phenomenon, not a split artifact.
blocks.zh: 凤凰网的LOCO退化反映了跨城市转移,而不是分裂的异质性. 凤凰城内部的分裂在统计上与每一次诊断相匹配,而LOCO协议在凤凰城被扣时并未借鉴凤凰城的训练分裂. 凤凰网下层的上层波纹部分是机械的:凤凰网的阴影覆盖(5.7 5.7 — 6.7 % 6.7 —% )大约是芝加哥/迈阿密(8.7 8.7 — 15.1 % 15.1 —%)的一半,小目标分数(0.80 0.80 — 0.82 0.81 0.41 — 0.50 0.50)几乎是高的两倍,平均R通道强度与 20\sim 20 单位(§ C.2 )有差异。 所有三个属性都压制mIoU,无论型号质量如何. 因此,表2中报告的跨城市差距是一个真正的转移现象,而不是一分为二的文物。

blocks.en: Chicago highres carries a known, bounded caveat. The paired-coordinate test set covers a narrower geographic band than the random training set, producing the + 19 % +19\% shift in test-set shadow coverage documented above. This affects Chicago’s Upper Bound (and therefore the magnitude of Δ \Delta in cells where Chicago is held out) but does not introduce circularity into the held-out-city evaluation, since LOCO never co-locates Chicago train and Chicago test. The direction of bias is conservative for our headline claim: Chicago already posts the highest Upper Bound in Table 2 , so a slight under-estimate of its true Upper Bound would only widen the reported LOCO gap. We disclose the caveat explicitly and release per-patch metadata ( pair_id , lon , lat , source_tile_id ) so downstream users can re-split if a fully matched protocol is required for their analysis.
blocks.zh: 芝加哥高地有一条明目张胆的警告 配对坐标测试集覆盖了比随机训练集更窄的地理波段,产生上面所记载的测试设置阴影覆盖度的+19%+19\%的转变. 这影响了芝加哥的上界(因此也影响了\\Delta在芝加哥被拒的牢房中的规模 ) , 但并没有将循环性引入被拒的城外评价,因为LOCO从不将芝加哥列车和芝加哥测试合用同一位置. 偏见的方向对我们的头条索赔是保守的: 芝加哥在表2中已经登上最高的上界点, 因此略微低估其真正的上界点只会扩大LOCO的缺口。 我们明确披露警告,并发布每个patch元数据(对称_id,lon,lat,source_tile_id),这样下游用户如果需要完全匹配的协议来进行分析,就可以重新分解.

blocks.en:
Rationale for the ± 2 \pm 2 -pixel tolerance. Annotators draw boundaries on the pixel grid and SAM-proposed boundaries
inherit the same quantization, but the true projected shadow edge depends
on the sub-pixel position of the occluder and the sun angle, so pixel-exact
boundary agreement is unachievable in principle. At 0.3 0.3 m/px, two pixels
correspond to ∼ 0.6 \sim\!0.6 m on the ground — smaller than the typical
width of a tree trunk or roof eave, comparable to the annotator-quantization
scale on gold images, and well below the scale of genuine geometric errors
that LOCO transfer should expose. Every number in the paper uses K = 2 K=2 .

blocks.en: Appendix F Training configurations

blocks.en:
This appendix documents the architecture and training configuration for
each of the four architectures (MAMNet, OGLANet, DINOv3, CrossEarth)
and the eight adaptation methods (FDA, SegDeSiC, IIM, ISW, MRFP+, FADA,
BSM, SAR). SegDeSiC, IIM, ISW, MRFP+ and FADA are not run on
CrossEarth, whose query-based Mask2Former decoder has no per-pixel head
these methods are defined on. Each adaptation block lists only those
hyperparameters that differ from the corresponding base configuration;
values matching the base are omitted.

blocks.en: F.8 OGLANet
blocks.zh: F.8 欧格兰特

blocks.en:
Architecture. OGLANet [ 17 ] is a four-stage encoder–decoder with
dense skip connections. The encoder consists of five Global-Local
Aware Module (GLAM) stages on top of a ResNet-34 backbone (pretrained
on ImageNet via torchvision.models.resnet34 ); the original
paper specifies ResNet-101, but ResNet-34 is substituted to match
MAMNet’s parameter budget. Each GLAM wraps one ResNet layer (LFEM)
between two GFEM self-attention modules ( 1 × 1 1{\times}1 Q/K/V
projections, sigmoid-gated, followed by 3 × 3 3{\times}3 conv with
stride 2 for downsampling or stride 1 for refinement). GLAM5 is an
additional stage (not in the original figure) that expands 512 → \to 1024
channels with a stride-2 3 × 3 3{\times}3 conv plus a non-downsampling
GFEM. The DFFM forms four decoder maps S 1 D S^{D}_{1} – S 4 D S^{D}_{4} by
concatenating multi-scale encoder features iteratively downsampled
with stride-2 3 × 3 3{\times}3 convs, each followed by a 1 × 1 1{\times}1 channel-reduction conv (BN-ReLU). The decoder bilinearly upsamples
DFFM features through Conv 3 × 3 3{\times}3 -BN-ReLU blocks, producing
outputs at { 12 × 12 , 48 × 48 , 96 × 96,384 × 384 } \{12{\times}12,48{\times}48,96{\times}96,384{\times}384\} . The OAM produces six 1 × 1 1{\times}1 -conv predictions: P 1 P_{1} – P 4 P_{4} from the four decoder scales, P 5 P_{5} from concat ⁡ ( P 1 : P 4 ) \operatorname{concat}(P_{1}{:}P_{4}) , P 6 P_{6} from concat ⁡ ( P 1 : P 5 ) \operatorname{concat}(P_{1}{:}P_{5}) . All six are deeply supervised at
training; only P 6 P_{6} is used at inference. Input is 384 × 384 × 4 384{\times}384{\times}4 (RGBC); the contrast-channel conv1 weight is
initialised as the channel-mean of the pretrained RGB weights.
Output stride 1.
blocks.zh:
建筑学. OGLANET [17] 是一个四级编码器-解码器,与
密集跳过连接 。 编码器由5个全球-当地雇员组成
ResNet-34主干线之上的有意识模块(GLAM)阶段(预训)
在ImageNet上通过f炬vision.models.resnet34); 原作

blocks.en:
DFFM reimplementation defect. We reimplemented the DFFM from the published architecture figure, and the
reimplementation makes OGLANet inference depend on the random state and the
batch size. Its 20 20 downsampling convolutions and their batch-normalization
layers are constructed inside forward() on every call and never
registered as modules. They are absent from the checkpoint, receive fresh
random weights on every forward pass, and stay in training mode under model.eval() , so they normalize with the statistics of the current
batch. With a fixed seed, inference is bit-identical across jobs and nodes.
Over repeated unseeded passes of one checkpoint on the same 150 150 test images,
the standard deviation of the cell mean reaches 0.42 0.42 mIoU. Changing the
inference seed among three values moves the cell mean by up to 0.66 0.66 mIoU on
an OGLANet- SIB checkpoint and by up to 1.37 1.37 mIoU on a published Vanilla
checkpoint, both on Chicago at high resolution. Every OGLANet value in the
paper is one inference pass at its run’s inference batch size, and its
confidence interval does not include this variation. We left the module
unchanged because every reported OGLANet number was produced with it, and the
released code contains the same module.

blocks.en: F.22 CrossEarth

blocks.en:
CrossEarth. We train CrossEarth [ 9 ] from its official release
on our splits, starting from the release’s
DINOv2 [ 43 ] ViT-L/14 backbone initialisation at patch
size 16. The backbone is frozen; the trainable components are the Rein
adapters [ 44 ] (token length 100, LoRA rank 16) and a
Mask2Former decoder [ 45 ] with a two-class head.
The code release omits four components described in the CrossEarth paper
(the Geospatial Semantic Extractor, the cross-attention Injector, the
masked-image-modelling branch with its ASPP decoder, and Earth-Style
Injection), so our cells train the released Rein and Mask2Former
configuration without the Million-AID style pool. No CrossEarth
per-benchmark checkpoint is used. Table 30 lists the configuration and our deviations from the release, which
adapt it to our 384 × 384 384{\times}384 patches, our 450 450 -image training
sets, the 4-hour partition limit, and source-only validation.

blocks.en:
BSM. No official BSM code has been released, so we reimplemented it from
the paper [ 22 ] . At each training step a frozen AdaIN
style-transfer network [ 46 ] re-renders every image in
the batch with the style of another image from the same batch (a random
permutation with distinct pairs), and the result is mixed with the
original at a fixed coefficient α \alpha . The style source is the
training batch itself, so no external or held-out-city imagery enters
training. BSM is applied to the RGB input before the network, with the
architecture’s input normalisation inverted before mixing and reapplied
after; the contrast channel of MAMNet and OGLANet passes through
unmodified. BSM is disabled at evaluation. Each architecture otherwise
keeps its base configuration (Tables 9 , 16 , 23 , 30 ). The DINOv3/Chicago cell collapsed at
seed 0 (best source-city validation mIoU 5.51 5.51 , below the training
floor of 10.0 10.0 ) and is excluded from Table 2 without
imputation.

blocks.en: F.24 SAR
blocks.zh: F.24 搜索和救援

blocks.en:
SAR. SAR [ 28 ] trains nothing. It adapts the normalisation-layer
affine parameters of each cell’s Vanilla LOCO checkpoint (for MAMNet,
the matched-450 retrain) on each test image’s own prediction, by
minimising the entropy of reliable pixels under sharpness-aware
minimisation [ 47 ] . We run it episodically at batch size
1: parameters are restored before every image, so nothing accumulates
across the target set, and no held-out-city label or source image is
used. Normalisation layers stay in evaluation mode on source running
statistics, because MAMNet and OGLANet return auxiliary and
deep-supervision outputs in training mode. We keep upstream’s skip list
and collect the affine parameters of every remaining BatchNorm,
LayerNorm and GroupNorm layer. The two-class entropy constants are
upstream’s, rescaled from C = 1000 C{=}1000 to C = 2 C{=}2 and never tuned on
target mIoU. When the reliability filter admits no pixel, the step is
skipped. Each SAR row in Table 2 is the Vanilla
cell’s per-image values plus the change SAR produces within its own
pass (final step minus step 0), so the row isolates the adaptation
effect from any difference between the SAR pass and the stored Vanilla
inference.
