blocks.en: G.3 Histogram Matching Intervention
blocks.zh: G.3 直方图匹配干预

blocks.en: This appendix expands on the pixel-space test reported in Section 4.2 , which rules out input-preprocessing as a recovery strategy under LOCO.
blocks.zh: 本附录扩展了第4.2节所报告的像素-空间测试,其中排除了输入预处理作为LOCO下的一种恢复策略.

blocks.en: Procedure. For each (architecture, holdout city) cell under vanilla LOCO, we compute the aggregate intensity histogram (the mean of the three channels) of the source-city training images. We map each test image’s intensity CDF onto this histogram, restore each pixel’s ratio between its channels and its intensity, and run the trained model on the transformed image with no parameter changes. The intervention is parameter-free, applied at test time, and isolates the pixel-statistics hypothesis: if LOCO failure lives at the pixel level, aligning the marginal pixel distribution should recover at least part of the within-city upper bound.
blocks.zh: 2. 程序。 对于香草LOCO下的每个(architecture,holdout city)细胞,我们计算出源城训练图像的总强度直方图(三个通道的平均值). 我们把每个测试图像的强度 CDF 映射到这个直方图上, 恢复每个像素在它的通道和强度之间的比值, 在变形图像上运行经过训练的模型, 没有参数变化 。 该干预是无参数的,在测试时应用,并隔离像素-统计假说:如果LOCO失败维持在像素水平,调整边际像素分布应至少恢复部分城内上界.

blocks.en: Recovery and inflation. Section 4.2 reports the per-architecture median recovery ratio R R ; all three medians lie in [ − 2.72 , − 1.55 ] [-2.72,-1.55] with 95 % 95\% CIs below zero. At the median, matched images lie 2.5 2.5 to 3.7 3.7 times as far from the upper bound as the LOCO predictions. False-positive pixel counts rise on 5 5 of the 9 9 cells and fall on the other 4 4 . The largest rise is on MAMNet/Chicago, from 201 201 K LOCO false positives to 15.4 15.4 M after matching ( 76 × 76\times ). Counts are pooled over the 150 150 test images with the boundary-tolerant band of the original scorer. R R excludes images whose upper-minus-LOCO IoU is below 0.02 0.02 or undefined, and OGLANet values carry the nondeterminism of Appendix F.8 .
blocks.zh: 复苏和通货膨胀。 第4.2节报告人均建筑中位恢复比R R;所有三个中位数都位于[−2.72,−1.55][2.72,−1.55],95%的95%CI低于零。 在中位数上,匹配的图像比LOCO的预测值离上方界限的2.5至3.7倍。 假阳性像素计数在9个细胞中的5个5个上升,其他4个4个则下降. 最大的上升发生在MAMNet/芝加哥,从201 201 K LOCO假阳性上升至15.4 15.4 匹配后M(76×76\时). 150个测试图像的计数与原始计分器的边界耐界波段合并。 R不包括其上位-负-LOCO IoU低于0.02 0.02或未定义的图像,OGLANet值带有附录F.8的非定值.

blocks.en: Implication. The destruction is uniform and large: 0 0 of 9 9 cells improve, and the inflation pattern indicates the model’s features are tied to the joint distribution of intensity, texture, and spatial pattern in source-city imagery. Marginal pixel-distribution alignment breaks this coupling without replacing it. Any recovery strategy that operates only on input statistics (gamma correction, contrast normalization, single-channel histogram standardization) faces the same structural problem.
blocks.zh: 释义. 破坏是统一和大的:9个单元中的0 0 改进了,通货膨胀模式表明模型的特征与源城图像中强度、纹理和空间模式的联合分布有关。 边际像素分布对齐打破了这种耦合而不替换. 任何只使用输入统计(伽玛校正,对比常态,单通道直径标准化)的恢复战略,都面临着相同的结构问题.

blocks.en: G.4 Selective-Prediction Gap: Per-Cell Details
blocks.zh: G.4 选择性预测差距:每个公司的详细情况

blocks.en: This appendix expands the SP-gap analysis of Section 4.3 , which characterizes the LOCO failure as class-asymmetric foreground-confidence collapse.
blocks.zh: 本附录扩展了第4.3节的SP-gap分析,将LOCO故障定性为类不对称前缘自信崩溃.

blocks.en: Bootstrap procedure. For each of the 63 63 LOCO cells (architecture × \times method × \times holdout city, high-resolution only), we compute per-image risk-coverage curves on three pixel populations: foreground ( gt_pos , confidence = p =p ), background ( gt_bg , confidence = 1 − p =1-p ), and all pixels (confidence = max ⁡ ( p , 1 − p ) =\max(p,1-p) ). The SP gap is AURC LOCO − AURC upper \text{AURC}_{\text{LOCO}}-\text{AURC}_{\text{upper}} ; image-level paired bootstrap ( B = 1,000 B=1{,}000 ) gives 95 % 95\% CIs on the gap. Cells are paired by image because both upper and LOCO models evaluate on the same 150 150 test images per cell.
blocks.zh: 诱饵程序。 对于63个LOCO细胞(Architecture ×\times method ×\times holdout city,仅高分辨率),我们计算三个像素人群的每个图像风险覆盖曲线:前缘(gt_pos,置信=p),背景(gt_bg,置信=1-p),以及所有像素(自信=最大=QX(p, 1-p)). SP空档是 AURC LOCO – AURC 上\text{AURC {text{LOCO}}}-\text{AURC {text{upper}}};图像级配对的靴子(B=1000 B=1{,}000)在空档上给出95%的95% CI. 细胞由图像配对,因为上层模型和LOCO模型都对每个细胞150个相同的测试图像进行评价.

blocks.en: Class-asymmetry distribution. The pooled means reported in Section 4.3 (foreground gap + 0.136 +0.136 , background gap + 0.006 +0.006 ) reflect a stable per-cell pattern: the foreground gap exceeds the background gap in 55 55 of 63 63 cells (sign-test p = 4.9 × 10 − 10 p=4.9\times 10^{-10} ). The per-method breakdown shown in Figure 3 (b) confirms the asymmetry holds for every adaptation method individually; no method produces a foreground gap smaller than its background gap on average.
blocks.zh: 阶级不对称分布. 第4.3节(前方差距+0.136+0.136,后方差距+0.006+0.006)中报告的集合手段反映了稳定的每个细胞模式:前方差距超过63个细胞中的55个(签名测试p=4.9×10 – 10 p=4.9\times 10^{-10}). 图3(b)所示的按方法分列的细目证实,每种适应方法各自都存在不对称现象;没有任何方法产生比其平均背景差距小的前缘差距。

blocks.en: Logit and ECE corroboration. Two independent per-pixel measurements track the same asymmetry. At the logit level, true-positive logits drop by 0.85 0.85 nats on average while false-positive logits drop by 0.15 0.15 nats; the asymmetry holds in 55 55 of 63 63 cells. Expected calibration error rises by 0.064 0.064 on predicted-positive pixels and is unchanged ( − 0.001 -0.001 ) on predicted-negative pixels; the rise is larger on the predicted-positive side in 44 44 of 54 54 cells (nine cells excluded for insufficient predicted-positive coverage on the calibration split). The three measurements (AURC gap, logit drift, ECE rise) are independent in the sense that they depend on different functions of the prediction distribution, and all three identify the foreground-class population as the locus of degradation.
blocks.zh: 逻辑和欧洲经委会的佐证。 两个独立的每像素测量跟踪相同的不对称. 在对数一级,真阳性对数平均下降0.85 0.85纳特,而假阳性对数下降0.15 0.15纳特;不对称在63个细胞中的55个细胞。 预计校准误差在预测阳性像素上上升0.0640.064,在预测阴性像素上不变(−0.001-0.01);在54个细胞中的44个细胞中,预测阳性方面的上升较大(9个细胞不包括在校准分裂上预测阳性覆盖不足). 三种测量(AURC差距、对数漂移、欧洲经委会上升)是独立的,因为它们取决于预测分布的不同功能,所有三种测量都把前地级人口确定为退化地点。

blocks.en: G.5 Cross-Entropy AURC Under-Reporting
blocks.zh: G.5 交叉输入 AURC 报告不足

blocks.en: This appendix details the methodological finding that standard 0 / 1 0/1 evaluation under-reports the LOCO calibration failure by 2.3 × 2.3\times , motivating the cross-entropy framing in Section 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 本附录详述了方法结论,即标准0/0/1评价将LOCO校准故障报告为2.3×2.3\时,从而激发了第4.3节的交叉内涵。

blocks.en: Why 0 / 1 0/1 -AURC misses the calibration component. The standard AURC measures per-pixel 0 / 1 0/1 error: a pixel is correct if its predicted class matches the ground truth, regardless of the predicted probability. Two models that produce identical rank orderings of pixels by confidence yield identical 0 / 1 0/1 risk-coverage curves, even if one assigns probability 0.99 0.99 to a correct pixel and the other assigns 0.55 0.55 . The 0 / 1 0/1 -AURC is invariant to any monotonic rescaling of the probability outputs.
blocks.zh: 为什么0 / 1 0/1 - AURC 错过校准组件 。 标准的 AURC 测量每像素 0 / 1 0/1 错误:一个像素如果其预测的类与地面真理相符,无论预测的概率如何,都是正确的. 两种模型通过置信产生相同的像素排序,得出相同的0 / 1 0/1 风险覆盖曲线,即使一种给一个正确的像素分配概率0.99 0.99,另一种给0.55 0.55. 0 / 1 0/1 - AURC 与概率输出的任何单调回缩放都不一致 。

blocks.en: Cross-entropy AURC replaces 0 / 1 0/1 error with per-pixel cross-entropy: − log ⁡ p -\log p on foreground pixels and − log ⁡ ( 1 − p ) -\log(1-p) on background pixels. CE-AURC depends on the probability values themselves, not just rank order, and therefore detects calibration collapse that leaves the rank ordering intact.
blocks.zh: Cross-entropy AURC用每个像素的交叉射线替换错误0 / 1 0/1 : – log ⁡ p-\log p 在前方像素上和 – log ⁡ (1 − p) -\log (1-p) 在后方像素上. CE-AURC取决于概率值本身,而不仅仅是排序顺序,因此检测到校准崩溃,使排序完好无损.

blocks.en: Result. The pooled CE-AURC gap exceeds the pooled 0 / 1 0/1 -AURC gap by a factor of 2.3 × 2.3\times on the foreground population ( + 0.315 +0.315 against + 0.136 +0.136 ). The cell-level direction is consistent: 60 60 of 63 63 cells have gap CE > gap 0 / 1 \text{gap}_{\text{CE}}>\text{gap}_{0/1} (one-sided paired Wilcoxon p = 2.3 × 10 − 11 p=2.3\times 10^{-11} ).
blocks.zh: 结果 集合的 CE-AURC 空隙超过集合 0 / 1 0/1 - AURC 空隙的系数为 2.3 × 2.3\时( + 0. 315 + 0. 315 对 + 0 136 + 0. 136 ) 。 单元格级别方向一致 : 63个单元格中有 60个有缺口 CE > 缺口 CE > 缺口 0 / 1\ text{ cE}}>\ { gap}_{0/1} (单侧配对的Wilcoxon p=2.3×10 – 11 p=2.3\times 10×11}).

blocks.en: Implication. Practitioners who evaluate selective deployment on 0 / 1 0/1 metrics alone observe less than half of the calibration degradation that cross-entropy scoring measures; the rest is hidden by the rank-invariance of 0 / 1 0/1 scoring. The under-reporting is not an artifact of the bootstrap or the bin width: it is a structural property of the metric.
blocks.zh: 释义. 仅在0/1 0/1公尺上评价选择性部署的从业者观察到的校准退化不足一半的跨交替积分测量;其余的则被0/1 0/1公分的等级变化所隐藏. 报告不足不是靴子或本位宽度的文物:它是度量标准的结构属性。

blocks.en: G.6 Coverage-Threshold Recovery and Calibration
blocks.zh: G.6 覆盖面 -- -- 临界值恢复和校准

blocks.en: This appendix details the operating-point recovery analysis and the failure of standard post-hoc calibration that together motivate the deployment-time component of SIB (Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 本附录详述了作业点恢复分析以及标准定点后校准的失败,这些都激励了SIB的部署时间部分(第5.1节)。

blocks.en: Recoverable-threshold definition. For each cell we define c ∗ = max ⁡ { c : err LOCO sel ​ ( c ) ≤ err upper ​ ( c = 1.0 ) + 0.005 } c^{*}=\max\{c:\text{err}_{\text{LOCO}}^{\text{sel}}(c)\leq\text{err}_{\text{upper}}(c{=}1.0)+0.005\} , the largest coverage at which the LOCO selective error on the foreground population matches the within-city full-coverage error within a 0.5 % 0.5\% tolerance. Image-level paired bootstrap on the per-image error stack gives a 95 % 95\% CI on c ∗ c^{*} . A finite c ∗ c^{*} exists in 59 59 of 63 63 cells. The four exceptions are all on Phoenix under aggressive adaptation methods (IIM, ISW, MRFP + ); on these cells, no selective-prediction threshold recovers within-city quality.
blocks.zh: 可回收阈值定义. 对于每个单元格,我们定义 c * = 最大 { { c : 错误 LOCO sel( c = 1.0 ) + 0.005 } c max { c :\ text{ err}_{\ text{LOCO}}^{\ text{ sel}}(c)\ leq\ text{ err}_{\ text{(c{=}1.0)+ 0.005},这是 LOCO在前方人群上的选择性错误与0.5% 容忍度范围内的全市内覆盖错误相匹配的最大覆盖度。 每幅图像错误堆栈上的图像级配对靴子绑定在 c * 上给出95% 95% CI 。 在63个细胞中的59 59 个细胞中存在一个有限度的 c 。 四个例外都是在凤凰城采用积极的改造方法(IIM,ISW,MRFP + );在这些细胞上,没有选择性的预测阈值恢复城市内部的质量.

blocks.en: Required threshold magnitude. Among the 59 59 recoverable cells, the median c ∗ c^{*} corresponds to discarding 25 % 25\% of foreground pixels. On Phoenix the median is 40 % 40\% .

Method-ranking stability. We rank the seven methods (Vanilla and six adaptation methods) on the per-method mean foreground SP gap, separately for each of the three architectures, and compute Kendall’s coefficient of concordance across the three rankings: W = 0.79 W=0.79 ( p = 0.027 p=0.027 , chi-square approximation over 7 7 methods). FDA has the smallest pooled gap ( + 0.05 +0.05 ) and ISW the largest ( + 0.22 +0.22 ), and the pooled ordering is FDA < < Vanilla < < FADA < < SegDeSiC < < IIM < < MRFP + < < ISW. FDA ranks first on all three architectures, and ISW and MRFP + each rank between fifth and seventh. On MAMNet, IIM, ISW and MRFP + reach + 0.22 +0.22 , + 0.23 +0.23 and + 0.25 +0.25 .
blocks.zh: 方法等级稳定. 我们把七种方法(瓦尼利亚和六种适应方法)排在每种方法的平均前景SP差距上,对三种建筑分别进行分类,并计算肯德尔在三个等级上的一致系数:W=0.79 W=0.79(p=0.027 p=0.027,Chi-square 近似于7-7方法). 林业发展局的集合差距最小(+ 0.05+ 0.05),社会福利署最大的(+ 0.22+ 0.22),集合定购是林业发展局的 " 香草 " < FADA > < SegDeSiC > < IIM < MRFP + < ISW。 FDA在所有三个建筑中排名第一,ISW和MRFP+各排名在第五至第七. 在MAMNet上,IM,ISW和MRFP+达到+0.22+0.22,+0.23+0.23和+0.25+0.25.

blocks.en: Post-hoc temperature scaling fails under cross-source-city transfer. Standard practice for calibration repair is to fit a single temperature T T on a labeled validation set. We test this directly: per cell, fit T T on the source-city validation split (the only labeled data available pre-deployment), apply to the held-out city. The recovery is indistinguishable from no calibration (paired Wilcoxon against zero recovery, p = 0.19 p=0.19 ); on 26 26 of 63 63 cells, the fitted-on-source temperature actively degrades held-out performance. Coverage thresholding is the only label-free recipe we identify that recovers within-city quality on the held-out city.
blocks.zh: 在跨源城市传输中,后热温度缩放失败. 校准修补的标准做法是在标注的验证装置上安装单一温度TT. 我们直接测试这一点:每个单元格,在源城验证分拆上安装T T(唯一标注在部署前的数据),适用于被搁置的城市。 回收与无校准是分不开的(Paired Wilcoxon对零回收,p=0.19 p=0.19);在63个电池中的26个电池上,安装在源头上的温度会积极降解阻断性能. 覆盖阈值是我们唯一发现的无标签的食谱 在被扣留的城市恢复城市内部的质量。

blocks.en: G.7 INRIA Cross-Task Replication
blocks.zh: G.7 INRIA 跨任务复制

blocks.en: This appendix details the cross-task replication on INRIA building footprint extraction [ 33 ] , used in Section 4.3 to test whether the SP-gap findings reflect properties of geographic LOCO or of shadow appearance.
blocks.zh: 本附录详细介绍了关于INRIA建筑脚印提取的跨任务复制[33],第4.3节用于检验SP-gap结论是否反映了地理LOCO或阴影外观的特性.

blocks.en: Dataset and protocol. INRIA provides 5,000 × \times 5,000-pixel aerial tiles at 0.3 0.3 m GSD over five cities; we use Austin, Chicago, and Vienna to match the three-city LOCO structure of ShadowTransfer . From each city’s labeled tiles we sample 750 750 non-overlapping 384 × 384 384\times 384 patches under a fixed seed, split into 450 450 training, 150 150 validation, and 150 150 test images: identical sample sizes to ShadowTransfer ’s per-city splits at high resolution. Patches with more than 30 % 30\% nodata are rejected before sampling. The three LOCO folds (holdout Austin, Chicago, Vienna) follow the same train-on-two/test-on-one structure as Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 数据集与协议. INRIA提供 5000×时 5000-像素 空中瓷砖 0.3米 GSD 超过5个城市; 我们使用奥斯汀,芝加哥,和维也纳 与Shadow Transfer的三城 LOCO结构相匹配。 从每个城市的标牌瓦片中,我们从固定种子下抽取750 750个非重叠的384×384\时的384块补丁,分为450 450个训练,150 150个验证和150 150个测试图像:相同的样本大小是Shadow Transfer在高分辨率下对每个城市的分数。 超过30%的无数据补丁在采样前被拒绝 。 三个LOCO折叠(holdout Austin, Chicago, Vienna)采用与3.3节相同的列车对二/试编组.

blocks.en: Training matched to shadow. We train MAMNet from scratch using the identical hyperparameters as the shadow MAMNet (Adam lr = 10 − 4 \text{lr}=10^{-4} , batch 8 8 , 100 100 epochs, ReduceLROnPlateau with patience 3 3 , early stopping patience 10 10 , ImageNet-pretrained 4 4 -channel ResNet- 34 34 encoder with the contrast channel initialized from RGB mean, MAMNet auxiliary loss with weight 0.4 0.4 , ± 2 \pm 2 px boundary tolerance). No hyperparameter is re-tuned for the new task. The class-balancing weight is recomputed from building label frequency using the same formula applied to shadow frequency. The resulting upper-bound mIoU lands in [ 0.74 , 0.81 ] [0.74,0.81] across cities, confirming the model is not in a data-starved regime for the task.
blocks.zh: 训练与影子相匹配. 我们从头开始训练MAMNet,使用与影子MAMNet相同的超参数(Adam lr = 10 – 4\text{lr}=10^{-4},第8批8个,100个历程,用耐心的LindLROnPlateau 3 3 3,早期停止耐心 10,ImageNet-pressed 4 -channel ResNet-34 34 编码器从RGB平均值初始化的对比通道,MAMNet辅助损失,重量0.4 0.4,± 2\pm 2 px 边界容忍度). 没有为新任务重新调整超参数 。 使用适用于阴影频率的相同公式,从构建标签频率中重新计算出类平衡重量。 由此产生的上行mIoU在[0.74,0.81][0.74,0.81]城市间登陆,证实该模型在任务上没有数据耗尽的制度.

blocks.en: Replication outcomes. Pooling the three shadow MAMNet-vanilla cells with the three INRIA MAMNet-vanilla cells gives n = 6 n=6 for the cross-task test, where the smallest p p -value any sign test can return is 0.016 0.016 . Three findings transfer cleanly at the cell level: the foreground SP gap, the foreground-vs-background asymmetry, and the cross-entropy under-reporting each go in the same direction on all 6 6 cells, with cell-level effect sizes Cohen’s d > 1.1 d>1.1 and sign-test p = 0.016 p=0.016 each. The predicted-positive logit erosion transfers in direction on 5 5 of 6 6 cells (Wilcoxon p = 0.031 p=0.031 , d = 1.5 d=1.5 ). One signature does not transfer: the direction of class-stratified ECE flips between tasks. On INRIA Vienna, ECE rises by 0.138 0.138 on predicted-negative pixels and only 0.034 0.034 on predicted-positive pixels, the opposite of the shadow pattern.
blocks.zh: 复制结果。 将3个阴影的MAMNet-vanilla细胞与3个INRIA MAMNet-vanilla细胞汇合,给n=6n=6进行跨任务测试,其中最小的p-值任何标志测试可以返回的p-值为0.0160.016. 3个发现在细胞层中清洁转移:前缘SP间隙,前缘-vs-后缘不对称,以及交叉交替的漏报,每组在6个细胞上都朝同一方向前进,具有细胞层效应大小. Cohen的d > 1.1 d > 1.1,签号测试p=0.016 p=0.016 每人. 6个细胞中的5个细胞(Wilcoxon p = 0.031 p = 0.031,d = 1.5 d = 1.5)的预计阳性对数侵蚀转移方向。 一个签名是不会转移的:在任务之间进行分类的欧洲经委会翻转的方向。 在INRIA维也纳,欧洲经委会在预测负像素上上升了0.138 0.38,在预测正像素上上升了0.034 0.034,与阴影模式相反。

blocks.en: Interpretation. The class-stratified ECE direction is task-dependent, tracking which class is the population majority (sparse foreground in shadow, dense in INRIA), rather than reflecting a property of geographic LOCO. The other findings depend on properties of the foreground class under shift and replicate across both task semantics. We therefore retain the foreground-asymmetry, under-reporting, logit-erosion, and recoverability claims as properties of geographic LOCO across dense prediction, and explicitly scope the class-stratified ECE result to shadow.
blocks.zh: 释义. 被分级批准的欧洲经委会方向取决于任务,跟踪哪个阶层是人口的大多数(阴影中的前缘,在INRIA中密集),而不是反映地域LOCO的财产。 其它发现则取决于转向中并跨两个任务语义复制的前景类属性. 因此,我们保留了前地不对称、报告不足、登记侵蚀和可收回性索赔,作为地域LOCO的特性,通过密集预测,明确将经分类批准的欧洲经委会结果置于阴影之下。

blocks.en: G.8 Component-Retraining Experiments
blocks.zh: G.8 组件再培训实验

blocks.en: This appendix details the two controlled retraining experiments underlying Section 4.4 , which localize the recoverable failure component to the decoder for DINOv3, the encoder for OGLANet, and both for MAMNet.
blocks.zh: 本附录详述了作为第4.4节基础的两项可控再培训实验,这些实验将可回收的故障组件定位到DINov3的解码器、OGLANet的编码器和MAMNet的编码器。

blocks.en: Experiment A (decoder retraining). For each (architecture, holdout city) pair under vanilla LOCO, we freeze the encoder weights, reinitialize the decoder, and retrain only the decoder for 30 30 epochs on a randomly sampled 25 % 25\% of the holdout-city training set ( ≈ 110 \approx 110 images). The encoder receives no gradient updates. The retrained model is evaluated on the held-out city’s 150 150 test images by per-image foreground IoU with a boundary-tolerant band.

Experiment B (encoder retraining). The inverse setup: freeze the decoder, reset the encoder to its pretrained initialization (ImageNet for the CNN encoders, original DINOv3 weights for the ViT), and retrain only the encoder on the same 25 % 25\% subset. The decoder receives no gradient updates.
blocks.zh: 实验B(编码器再培训). 反向设置:冻结解码器,将编码器重置到其经过预先训练的初始化(用于CNN编码器的ImageNet,用于ViT的原DINOv3重量),仅在同25%的25QQ子集上重排编码器. 解码器没有收到梯度更新 。

blocks.en: Recovery ratio and exclusion. Recovery is measured by the per-image ratio R R . To avoid division by zero on images where the within-city gap is negligible, we exclude images with IoU upper − IoU LOCO < 0.02 \text{IoU}^{\text{upper}}-\text{IoU}^{\text{LOCO}}<0.02 . Pooling per architecture across the three holdout cities, we obtain 335 335 – 351 351 valid R R values per architecture per experiment. Image-cluster bootstrap ( B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 ) gives the medians and CIs reported in Section 4.4 ; the error bars of Figure 3 (c) come from a separate bootstrap ( B = 1,000 B=1{,}000 ) of the same per-image values. Each cell is one training run, and OGLANet values carry the nondeterminism of Appendix F.8 . The pattern, summarized in Table 40 , shows the central architecture-dependent locus claim: each architecture is recovered by one experiment and harmed or unaffected by the other.

blocks.en: Why DINOv3’s encoder retraining harms. The negative DINOv3 Exp. B result reflects tight encoder-decoder coupling: the LOCO decoder was trained jointly with a pretrained ViT encoder that barely moved during fine-tuning (whole-encoder relative L 2 L_{2} change of 0.019 0.019 from initialization, Appendix H.4 ). Resetting the encoder to its pretrained initialization changes the feature distribution slightly, and the frozen decoder cannot adapt to the new feature space. The performance drops below the LOCO baseline because the decoder is calibrated to a feature space the new encoder no longer produces.
blocks.zh: 为何DINov3的编码器再培训有害。 负 DINov3 Exp. B结果反映了紧密的编码器-解码器耦合:LOCO解码器与经过预先训练的ViT编码器一起训练,在微调时勉强移动(全编码器相对L 2 L_{2}从初始化中更改0.019 0.019,附录H.4 ). 将编码器重置到其预先训练的初始化中,会稍微改变特性分布,被冻结的解码器无法适应新的特性空间. 性能低于LOCO基线,因为解码器被校准为新编码器不再产生的特性空间.

blocks.en: Implication for adaptation method choice. The architecture-dependent locus directly explains the catastrophic failures in Table 2 . MRFP + perturbs encoder features uniformly without targeting OGLANet’s encoder-locus failure, so it costs OGLANet − 14.0 -14.0 mIoU against − 4.9 -4.9 on DINOv3. ISW whitens encoder feature covariance, which corrupts the pretrained representation DINOv3 depends on, so it costs DINOv3 − 18.5 -18.5 mIoU against − 11.1 -11.1 on OGLANet. The architecture-dependent recovery component predicts which adaptation methods will fail catastrophically on a given architecture before the method is run.
blocks.zh: 对适应方法选择的影响。 建筑依赖的蝗虫直接解释了表2中的灾难性故障. MRFP + 扰动编码器的特性统一,而不针对OGLANet的编码器-locus故障,因此它花费了OGLANet − 14.0 -14.0 mIoU 相对于 DINov3 上的− 4.9 -4.9. ISW 白子编码器的特性是共变,它腐蚀了预先训练过的DINov3所依赖的表示,因此它花费了DINov3 − 18.5 - 18.5 mIoU对OGLANet上的− 11.1 - 11.1. 依赖架构的恢复部分预测,在某一架构运行之前,哪些适应方法将灾难性地失败。

blocks.en: H.4 Pretraining and fine-tuning regime

blocks.en:

blocks.en: Appendix J SIB Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录 J SIB 执行详情

blocks.en: SIB sits between the encoder and the decoder of any backbone. Encoder features F ∈ ℝ C × H × W F\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W} are decomposed via a single-level 2D Haar wavelet into four subbands { F L ​ L , F L ​ H , F H ​ L , F H ​ H } \{F_{LL},F_{LH},F_{HL},F_{HH}\} , each in ℝ C × H / 2 × W / 2 \mathbb{R}^{C\times H/2\times W/2} . The Haar transform uses no learned parameters and is perfectly invertible; gradients propagate cleanly through the forward and inverse operations. Compressed subbands are recombined by inverse Haar before being passed to the decoder.
blocks.zh: SIB坐落在任何骨干编码器和解码器之间. 编码器的特性 F ∈ R C × H× W F\in\ mathbb{ R\ C\ tims H\times W}通过单级的2D Haar波段分解成四个子带 {F L L, F L H, F H } {F_{L}L}, F_{L}L}, F_{HLH}\}}, F_{H}\} }\}, 各在 R C × H / 2× W / 2  mathbbbR}^{C\Times H/2\Times W/2}. Haar变换没有使用学到的参数,完全不可逆;梯度通过前向和反向操作清洁传播. 压缩的子带在传递到解码器之前通过反向Haar重新组合.

The KL penalty against the standard Gaussian prior p ⁡ ( Z L ​ L ) = 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I ) p(Z_{LL})=\mathcal{N}(0,I) is weighted by an intensity-conditioned coefficient β content ​ ( x ) = β base + β scale ⋅ σ ⁡ ( MLP ​ ( I local ​ ( x ) ) ) , \beta_{\text{content}}(x)=\beta_{\text{base}}+\beta_{\text{scale}}\cdot\sigma\!\left(\text{MLP}(I_{\text{local}}(x))\right), (4) where I local ​ ( x ) I_{\text{local}}(x) is the mean pixel intensity in a local window around spatial location x x , computed from the original RGB input and downsampled to the bottleneck resolution. blocks.en: For U-Net architectures (MAMNet, OGLANet), each skip connection passes through a channel-wise sigmoid gate computed by global average pooling followed by a C → C C\to C linear layer. The pattern is consistent across cells: smaller τ \tau yields a less aggressive operating point (larger c v ​ a ​ l ∗ c^{*}_{val} , smaller magnitude held-out reduction); larger τ \tau yields a more aggressive operating point (smaller c v ​ a ​ l ∗ c^{*}_{val} , larger magnitude reduction). The DINOv3-Phoenix cell is the smallest in magnitude across all three settings, consistent with this cell’s small within-city to LOCO gap (per Appendix K ); even on this cell, all τ \tau settings produce a non-trivial reduction.
